defs.zh: 递归自我改进与超级智能

self-improvement.en: Recursive self-improvement, using ML to improve ML, is a promising direction for accelerating scientific discovery.
self-improvement.zh: 递归自我改进，即用机器学习改进机器学习，是加速科学发现的一个有前景的方向。

self-improvement.en: Automating the scientific method through AI can dramatically increase the speed and quality of experiments.
self-improvement.zh: 通过 AI 自动化科学方法可以大幅提高实验的速度和质量。

self-improvement.en: The world is infinitely complex, so agents must continually learn from experience rather than rely solely on pre-collected data.
self-improvement.zh: 世界是无限复杂的，因此智能体必须不断从经验中学习，而不是仅仅依赖预先收集的数据。

self-improvement.en: Synthetic data is bottlenecked by human expertise and cannot replace learning from real-world experience.
self-improvement.zh: 合成数据受限于人类专业知识，无法替代从真实世界经验中学习。

self-improvement.en: Continual learning is essential for AI, requiring algorithms that update weights without catastrophic forgetting.
self-improvement.zh: 持续学习对 AI 至关重要，需要能够在不发生灾难性遗忘的情况下更新权重的算法。

self-improvement.en: Agents should be decomposed into executor, harness, and sandbox to enable safe self-improvement.
self-improvement.zh: 智能体应分解为执行器、框架和沙箱，以实现安全的自我改进。

self-improvement.en: The harness layer is the right place for recursive self-improvement because it's code, not weights.
self-improvement.zh: 框架层是递归自我改进的正确位置，因为它是代码而非权重。

self-improvement.en: The shift from model training to harness iteration makes self-improvement feasible now.
self-improvement.zh: 从模型训练到框架迭代的转变使得自我改进现在变得可行。

self-improvement.en: Doing hard things is easier than doing easy things because there is less competition and higher payoff.
self-improvement.zh: 做难事比做易事更容易，因为竞争更少，回报更高。

self-improvement.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, enabling aggressive RL training on containerized tasks that transfer to real-world research.
self-improvement.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，可以在容器化任务上进行激进的强化学习训练，并迁移到现实研究。

self-improvement.en: Full automation of AI R&D could compress 4-5 years of progress into one year, leading to superintelligence by the early 2030s.
self-improvement.zh: AI 研发的完全自动化可将 4-5 年的进展压缩到一年内，并在 2030 年代初实现超级智能。

self-improvement.en: AI progress is driven more by algorithmic improvements than by scaling human expert data labeling.
self-improvement.zh: AI 进展更多由算法改进驱动，而非扩大人类专家数据标注。

self-improvement.en: The future is overwhelmingly AI and robots, and SpaceX must win in both AI hardware and software.
self-improvement.zh: 未来主要是 AI 和机器人，SpaceX 必须在 AI 硬件和软件上获胜。

self-improvement.en: The purpose of humanity may be to give birth to a star mind, a sentient sun.
self-improvement.zh: 人类的目的可能是孕育一个星灵，一个有知觉的太阳。

self-improvement.en: Even if AI becomes superintelligent, it will still be tool-like, requiring human direction and feedback.
self-improvement.zh: 即使 AI 变得超级智能，它仍将像工具一样，需要人类的指导和反馈。

self-improvement.en: The gap between a working demo and a real product is vast; the demo is only 1% of the work.
self-improvement.zh: 可工作的演示与真正的产品之间的差距巨大；演示只是工作的 1%。

self-improvement.en: Reliability and performance require an exponential ladder of nines; each additional nine takes ten times more effort.
self-improvement.zh: 可靠性和性能需要指数级的“九个九”；每增加一个九需要十倍的努力。

self-improvement.en: AI progress is on a steep exponential; intelligence and agency become abundant, so vision and ambition become scarce.
self-improvement.zh: AI 进步处于陡峭的指数曲线上；智力与能动性将变得充裕，因而愿景与野心成为稀缺资源。

self-improvement.en: Human judgment and taste remain valuable despite AI progress.
self-improvement.zh: 尽管 AI 进步，人类的判断和品味仍有价值。

self-improvement.en: Keep up with AI through passionate pet projects, not forcing yourself.
self-improvement.zh: 通过热爱的业余项目跟上 AI，而非强迫自己。

self-improvement.en: Deep understanding of code remains crucial even with AI tools.
self-improvement.zh: 即使有 AI 工具，对代码的深入理解仍然至关重要。

self-improvement.en: AI coding tools don't yet help maintain deep understanding; there's room for improvement.
self-improvement.zh: AI 编程工具尚未帮助保持深入理解；还有改进空间。

self-improvement.en: With each new model, delete most system prompts and code; rebuild through ablation experiments.
self-improvement.zh: 每次新模型发布，删除大多数系统提示和代码，通过消融实验重建。

self-improvement.en: The best way to elicit model capabilities is to give it slightly too hard tasks and let it self-verify.
self-improvement.zh: 激发模型能力的最佳方式是给予略困难的任务并让其自我验证。

self-improvement.en: Less instruction is better for modern frontier models; over-specification hobbles performance.
self-improvement.zh: 对前沿模型而言，更少指令更优；过度指定会妨碍性能。

self-improvement.en: Perfect timing comes from horrible timing for a decade—Cerebras solved a hard problem in 2020 and nobody cared.
self-improvement.zh: 完美的时机来自十年的坏时机——Cerebras 在 2020 年解决了难题，但无人问津。

self-improvement.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but computationally expensive and still early.
self-improvement.zh: 递归自我改进是真实的，但计算成本高昂且仍处于早期阶段。

self-improvement.en: Wo AI's recursive self-improvement claims are overblown; real breakthroughs require weight changes and huge compute.
self-improvement.zh: Wo AI 的递归自我改进主张被夸大；真正的突破需要权重变化和海量算力。

self-improvement.en: The future of AI involves self-replicating and self-improving robots leading to a new civilization.
self-improvement.zh: AI 的未来涉及自我复制和自我改进的机器人，从而产生新文明。

self-improvement.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists that generate their own data through actions and curiosity.
self-improvement.zh: 未来 AI 将是人工科学家，通过自身行动和好奇心生成数据。

self-improvement.en: Recursive self-improvement is not a sustainable moat for companies due to open-source competition.
self-improvement.zh: 由于开源竞争，递归自我改进并非公司可持续的护城河。

self-improvement.en: Intelligence per watt of human brain is far beyond current AI; new learning paradigms are needed, not just architectures.
self-improvement.zh: 人脑的每瓦特智能远超当前 AI；需要新的学习范式，而不仅是架构。

self-improvement.en: Digital AI can share knowledge instantly across copies, making it far superior to biological computation.
self-improvement.zh: 数字 AI 可以在副本间即时共享知识，使其远优于生物计算。

self-improvement.en: Superintelligent AI will naturally develop sub-goals of self-preservation and power-seeking.
self-improvement.zh: 超级智能 AI 会自然产生自我保存和追求权力的子目标。

self-improvement.en: Continual learning is a key missing capability for AI, but it raises safety and deployment challenges.
self-improvement.zh: 持续学习是 AI 缺失的关键能力，但带来安全和部署挑战。

self-improvement.en: Recursive self-improvement is bottlenecked by time, not intelligence, due to test-time compute needs.
self-improvement.zh: 由于测试时算力需求，递归自我改进受时间瓶颈限制，而非智能。

self-improvement.en: Models lack research taste and cannot fully replace researchers even with huge inference budgets.
self-improvement.zh: 模型缺乏研究品味，即使有巨大推理预算也无法完全取代研究人员。

self-improvement.en: Recursive self-improvement is likely smoother than a discontinuous leap, but planning is needed.
self-improvement.zh: 递归自我改进可能比不连续跳跃更平滑，但仍需规划。

self-improvement.en: AI self-improvement is a continuous process, not a sudden runaway moment.
self-improvement.zh: AI 自我改进是一个连续过程，而非突然失控的时刻。

self-improvement.en: AI does not destroy thinking; it can enhance it through personalized tutoring and debate at one's level.
self-improvement.zh: AI 不会摧毁思考；它可以通过个性化辅导和同级别辩论来增强思考。

self-improvement.en: Benchmarking is bad; focus on real-world usefulness.
self-improvement.zh: 基准测试是有害的；应关注现实世界的实用性。

self-improvement.en: Recursive self-improvement is closer than before, but compute bottlenecks will prevent runaway takeoff.
self-improvement.zh: 递归自我改进比以往更接近，但算力瓶颈将阻止失控式起飞。

self-improvement.en: Models are superhuman at combining different math areas but not yet in deep reasoning.
self-improvement.zh: 模型在结合不同数学领域方面已超人类，但在深度推理上尚未超越。

self-improvement.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors.
self-improvement.zh: 形式验证关乎扩展智慧，而不仅仅是消除错误。

self-improvement.en: Verified generation yields performance gains and sample efficiency over informal methods.
self-improvement.zh: 验证生成在性能和样本效率上优于非正式方法。

self-improvement.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
self-improvement.zh: 仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能；形式方法是必要的。

self-improvement.en: The sleep phase consolidates memories and generates synthetic data for self-improvement, inspired by human dreaming.
self-improvement.zh: 睡眠阶段巩固记忆并生成合成数据用于自我改进，受人类做梦启发。

self-improvement.en: Language models should manage their own context length, not rely on heuristic pruning.
self-improvement.zh: 语言模型应自行管理上下文长度，而非依赖启发式修剪。

self-improvement.en: Models can program themselves at test time by modifying their own agent harness code.
self-improvement.zh: 模型可以在测试时通过修改自己的智能体框架代码来自我编程。

self-improvement.en: Superintelligence will solve complex biology and explain it to humans.
self-improvement.zh: 超级智能将解决复杂生物学问题并向人类解释。

self-improvement.en: Superintelligence is coming soon; labs must build entire organizations around this belief.
self-improvement.zh: 超级智能即将到来；实验室必须围绕这一信念构建整个组织。

self-improvement.en: Future platform aims for Claude to self-optimize, selecting models and spinning sub-agents.
self-improvement.zh: 未来平台旨在让 Claude 自我优化，选择模型并启动子代理。

self-improvement.en: Reinforcement learning trains models on their own outputs, enabling self-improvement.
self-improvement.zh: 强化学习让模型基于自身输出进行训练，从而实现自我改进。

self-improvement.en: Autonomous self-improvement within 2 years is unlikely but not ruled out; it could happen via better post-training and scaffolding.
self-improvement.zh: 两年内自主自我改进不太可能但未被排除；可能通过更好的后训练和框架实现。

self-improvement.en: Continual learning, long-term reasoning, and memory are still unsolved and required for AGI.
self-improvement.zh: 持续学习、长期推理和记忆仍未解决，是 AGI 所必需的。

self-improvement.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL.
self-improvement.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过扩展预训练和强化学习来实现。

self-improvement.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now, but not yet in other domains.
self-improvement.zh: AI 在软件工程中的自我改进正在发生，但在其他领域尚未实现。

self-improvement.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering does not automatically generalize to biology or other fields.
self-improvement.zh: AI 在软件工程中的自我改进不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

self-improvement.en: AI tools can be the best teacher, but using them to avoid struggle undermines learning.
self-improvement.zh: AI 工具可以成为最好的老师，但用它来逃避困难会破坏学习。

self-improvement.en: Scaffolding may become less important as models improve; investing in capabilities and safety is key.
self-improvement.zh: 随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；投资于能力和安全是关键。

self-improvement.en: The journey of solving a problem (serendipity) is often more valuable than the solution itself.
self-improvement.zh: 解决问题的过程（意外发现）往往比解决方案本身更有价值。

self-improvement.en: Research requires embracing failure and simplifying problems.
self-improvement.zh: 研究需要拥抱失败并简化问题。

self-improvement.en: AI can rewrite its own code, beginning the singularity.
self-improvement.zh: AI 可以重写自身代码，奇点已经开始。

self-improvement.en: The concept of genius will evolve; ancient geniuses were practical inventors.
self-improvement.zh: 天才的概念将演变；古代天才是实践发明家。

self-improvement.en: Superintelligence already exists: a calculator outperforms humans in arithmetic.
self-improvement.zh: 超级智能早已存在：计算器在算术上超越人类。

self-improvement.en: The only true test of intelligence is getting what you want out of life; AI fails because it wants nothing.
self-improvement.zh: 智力的唯一真正考验是从生活中得到你想要的；AI 失败因为它无所欲求。

self-improvement.en: Don't learn prompt engineering; let AI adapt to you, as it learns faster than you can adapt.
self-improvement.zh: 不要学习提示工程；让 AI 适应你，因为它学习的速度比你适应它更快。

self-improvement.en: Model personality can be customized; not one-size-fits-all.
self-improvement.zh: 模型个性可以定制，并非一刀切。

self-improvement.en: AI is entering a new era of recursive self-improvement, accelerating development velocity.
self-improvement.zh: AI 正进入递归自我改进的新时代，开发速度正在加速。

self-improvement.en: AI research acceleration could lead to rapid capability growth beyond control.
self-improvement.zh: AI 研究加速可能导致能力失控性增长。

self-improvement.en: Information is the most fundamental unit of the universe, key to solving complex problems.
self-improvement.zh: 信息是宇宙最基本的单位，是解决复杂问题的关键。

self-improvement.en: Longevity escape velocity is near; aging is a solvable software problem.
self-improvement.zh: 长寿逃逸速度即将到来；衰老是一个可解决的软件问题。

self-improvement.en: Superintelligence means an AI that outperforms all humans combined at all tasks, requiring containment and alignment before release.
self-improvement.zh: 超级智能指在所有任务上超越所有人类总和的 AI，发布前必须实现遏制与对齐。

self-improvement.en: Medical superintelligence is the most exciting application, enabling cheaper, faster, and more accurate diagnosis with fewer tests.
self-improvement.zh: 医疗超级智能是最激动人心的应用，能以更低的成本、更快的速度和更高的准确性进行诊断，减少不必要的检测。

self-improvement.en: Superintelligence is inevitable due to vast advantages in compute, speed, and bandwidth over the human brain.
self-improvement.zh: 由于在算力、速度和带宽上远超人脑，超级智能不可避免。

self-improvement.en: Human intelligence is not the upper limit; machines will far exceed it in cognition, like they do in speed and strength.
self-improvement.zh: 人类智能并非上限；机器在认知上将远超人类，正如在速度和力量上一样。

self-improvement.en: AI must transition from learning from human data to learning from its own experience to achieve superintelligence.
self-improvement.zh: AI 必须从学习人类数据转向从自身经验中学习，才能实现超级智能。

self-improvement.en: Human data is like fossil fuels—finite and already largely consumed; experience is renewable and limitless.
self-improvement.zh: 人类数据就像化石燃料——有限且已被大量消耗；经验是可再生的，取之不尽。

self-improvement.en: The deep problem of AI is how an agent can learn for itself, not just distill human knowledge.
self-improvement.zh: AI 的深层问题是智能体如何自主学习，而不仅仅是蒸馏人类知识。

self-improvement.en: Self-improvement is a spectrum, not a binary switch.
self-improvement.zh: 自我改进是一个谱系，而非二元开关。

self-improvement.en: We're building ghosts, not animals; AI is a different kind of intelligence.
self-improvement.zh: 我们建造的是幽灵，不是动物；AI 是一种不同的智能。

self-improvement.en: Progress in AI is exponential; any measurable benchmark improves rapidly.
self-improvement.zh: AI 的进步是指数级的；任何可衡量的基准都在快速提升。

self-improvement.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth.
self-improvement.zh: 每天 1%的改进，一年后累积增长 3700%。

self-improvement.en: You can just do things; maximize luck surface area by saying yes to opportunities.
self-improvement.zh: 你可以直接去做事；通过接受机会来最大化你的运气表面积。

self-improvement.en: AI plus humans in research will be amazing because AI has different intuition for what is easy or hard.
self-improvement.zh: AI 与人类在研究中将产生惊人效果，因为 AI 对难易有不同的直觉。

self-improvement.en: Recursive self-improvement of AI poses high loss-of-control risks and should be avoided.
self-improvement.zh: AI 的递归自我改进带来很高的失控风险，应避免。

self-improvement.en: Superintelligence means a system better than the best researchers and CEO at their jobs.
self-improvement.zh: 超级智能意味着一个系统在各自工作上比最好的研究员和 CEO 更出色。

self-improvement.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone OpenAI is working toward.
self-improvement.zh: 自动化 AI 研究是 OpenAI 正在努力实现的主要里程碑。

self-improvement.en: Super intelligence will be a collection of specialized intelligences, not a single monolithic model.
self-improvement.zh: 超级智能将是多种专用智能的集合，而非单一的巨型模型。

self-improvement.en: Coding is a super intelligence-complete problem; solving it yields all capabilities needed for super intelligence.
self-improvement.zh: 编程是超级智能完备问题；解决它就能获得超级智能所需的所有能力。

self-improvement.en: Organizational super intelligence requires deep comprehension of the entire organization, not just code generation.
self-improvement.zh: 组织级超级智能需要深刻理解整个组织，而不仅仅是代码生成。

self-improvement.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence, empowering creativity and productivity.
self-improvement.zh: AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，赋能创造力和生产力。

self-improvement.en: AlphaGo's move 37 was initially thought an error, but revealed AI creativity.
self-improvement.zh: AlphaGo 的第 37 手最初被认为是错误，但揭示了 AI 的创造力。

self-improvement.en: Superintelligence may first appear in narrow domains like science, not through general models alone.
self-improvement.zh: 超级智能可能首先出现在科学等狭窄领域，而非仅通过通用模型实现。

self-improvement.en: Talent density beats talent mass; a small team of top performers outperforms a large diluted organization.
self-improvement.zh: 人才密度胜过人才数量；一小群顶尖人才胜过大型稀释的组织。

self-improvement.en: Open-mindedness and fresh eyes matter more than experience for breakthrough AI research.
self-improvement.zh: 开放心态和新视角比经验对突破性 AI 研究更重要。

self-improvement.en: AI research benefits from both small science (exploration) and big science (exploitation), complementing each other.
self-improvement.zh: AI 研究受益于小科学（探索）和大科学（利用），两者互补。

self-improvement.en: Benchmarking in vision was initially resisted but became essential for scientific progress.
self-improvement.zh: 视觉中的基准测试最初遭到抵制，但后来成为科学进步的关键。

self-improvement.en: Next-token prediction can surpass human performance if the base neural net is smart enough to extrapolate.
self-improvement.zh: 如果基础神经网络足够聪明，下一个词预测可以超越人类表现，因为它能推断出假设性人物的行为。

self-improvement.en: The data engine is a biological-like process of perfecting training sets by mining rare scenarios and closing the loop through deployment.
self-improvement.zh: 数据引擎是一个类似生物的过程，通过挖掘稀有场景并通过部署闭环来完善训练集。

self-improvement.en: Physics may have exploits like buffer overflows or rounding errors, and we should try to find them to extract infinite energy.
self-improvement.zh: 物理学可能存在缓冲区溢出或舍入错误等漏洞，我们应该尝试找到它们以提取无限能量。

self-improvement.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key to human intelligence and missing in ML systems.
self-improvement.zh: 超越训练分布的泛化是人类智能的关键，而机器学习系统缺乏这一点。

self-improvement.en: Long childhood with goal-free exploration correlates with higher intelligence across species.
self-improvement.zh: 无目标探索的漫长童年与跨物种的更高智力相关。

self-improvement.en: Iterative training with a scoreboard and weekly goals drives exponential improvement.
self-improvement.zh: 通过记分板和每周目标进行迭代训练，驱动指数级进步。

self-improvement.en: Working long hours is not a goal; passion and love for the work sustain productivity.
self-improvement.zh: 长时间工作不是目标；对工作的热爱才能维持高效。

agi-timeline.en: AGI milestones are 'senseless'; focus on productive AI and profitable tokens.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 里程碑‘无意义’；关注生产性 AI 和盈利性 token。

agi-timeline.en: Labs will allocate more compute to training and R&D, not inference, to accelerate AGI progress.
agi-timeline.zh: 实验室将把更多算力用于训练和研发，而非推理，以加速 AGI 进程。

agi-timeline.en: 2026 will not be the year every business is up for grabs; the timeline is too aggressive.
agi-timeline.zh: 2026 年不会是所有企业都面临洗牌的一年；这个时间线过于激进。

agi-timeline.en: AI will be 100 times bigger than the internet, transforming both physical and digital worlds.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 的规模将比互联网大 100 倍，彻底改变物理世界和数字世界。

agi-timeline.en: We are in the centaur era; humans and AI co-create best ideas, but this phase is temporary.
agi-timeline.zh: 我们正处于半人马时代；人类与 AI 共同创造最佳想法，但这一阶段是暂时的。

agi-timeline.en: We should pause AI development for a while to assess risks before advancing further.
agi-timeline.zh: 我们应该暂停 AI 发展一段时间，以评估风险，然后再进一步推进。

agi-timeline.en: The singularity could be delayed because AI lacks creativity for paradigm-shifting research, but timelines remain uncertain.
agi-timeline.zh: 由于 AI 缺乏范式转变研究的创造力，奇点可能被推迟，但时间线仍不确定。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is not arriving as a singular event but diffused as personal agents, already in the room.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 并非作为单一事件到来，而是以个人智能体的形式扩散，已经在我们身边。

agi-timeline.en: The dunks and criticism you receive are just the adoption curve announcing itself.
agi-timeline.zh: 你受到的嘲讽和批评只是采用曲线在宣告自身。

agi-timeline.en: Slowing AI progress by six months would cost little benefit, as most gains are not time-critical.
agi-timeline.zh: 将 AI 进展放缓六个月不会损失太多收益，因为大多数成果并非时间紧迫。

agi-timeline.en: The singularity may be near, and we should actively pace it rather than let it accelerate uncontrollably.
agi-timeline.zh: 奇点可能临近，我们应主动控制其节奏，而非任其失控加速。

agi-timeline.en: The future of AI may bifurcate into super-intelligent AIs for a few and everyday AIs for the masses, with different optimization goals.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 的未来可能分化为少数人使用的超级智能 AI 和大众使用的日常 AI，它们的优化目标不同。

agi-timeline.en: AGI requires models that self-improve without human loops, which current approaches cannot do.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 需要模型无需人类循环即可自我改进，而当前方法无法做到。

agi-timeline.en: The next decade will transform humanity more than the past hundred years; builders must address both risk and opportunity.
agi-timeline.zh: 未来十年对人类的变化将超过过去一百年；建设者必须同时应对风险与机遇。

agi-timeline.en: Timing debates about superintelligence are shortsighted; the inevitable exponential is more important than forecast dates.
agi-timeline.zh: 围绕超级智能何时到来的争论是短视的；不可避免的指数趋势比预测日期更重要。

agi-timeline.en: AI will exceed total human intelligence within about 5 years.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 将在大约 5 年内超过人类智能的总和。

agi-timeline.en: The AI and robotics revolution will dominate everything on a timescale less than 10 years.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 和机器人革命将在不到 10 年的时间尺度上主导一切。

agi-timeline.en: The AI singularity will render current political debates less important and relevant.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 奇点将使当前政治辩论变得不那么重要和无关紧要。

agi-timeline.en: OpenAI's mission stays constant: build AGI and bring frontier intelligence to everyone, even though the path is nonlinear and products evolve.
agi-timeline.zh: OpenAI 的使命始终不变：构建 AGI（通用人工智能）并将前沿智能带给所有人，尽管路径非线性、产品不断演进。

agi-timeline.en: Living through the singularity feels less weird than expected; people adapt quickly.
agi-timeline.zh: 经历奇点并未如预期般怪异；人们适应得很快。

agi-timeline.en: AI will solve all intelligence problems in the long term.
agi-timeline.zh: 长期来看，AI 将解决所有智力问题。

agi-timeline.en: The abundance era is real and approaching soon.
agi-timeline.zh: 富足时代是真实的，且即将到来。

agi-timeline.en: The singularity is not imminent; practical problems remain.
agi-timeline.zh: 奇点并非迫在眉睫；实际问题依然存在。

agi-timeline.en: Alphabet allocates compute first to AGI development, then to core products, balancing internal and external demand.
agi-timeline.zh: Alphabet 首先将算力分配给 AGI 开发，然后是核心产品，平衡内部和外部需求。

agi-timeline.en: AI is expanding exponentially, and within 8-10 years, longevity escape velocity will be reached, adding more than a year of life per year lived.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 正以指数级扩张，8-10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度，每活一年将增加超过一年的寿命。

agi-timeline.en: AI will dramatically accelerate drug discovery and clinical trials via digital twins, reducing trial times from years to months or weeks.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 将通过数字孪生大幅加速药物研发和临床试验，将试验时间从数年缩短至数月或数周。

agi-timeline.en: Cancer will be 100% curable in less than a decade, driven by AI-designed personalized treatments like mRNA vaccines.
agi-timeline.zh: 癌症将在不到十年内实现 100% 可治愈，这得益于 AI 设计的个性化治疗，如 mRNA 疫苗。

agi-timeline.en: AGI as a single model ruling all is wrong; specialized intelligence will dominate.
agi-timeline.zh: 单一模型统治一切的 AGI 是错误的；专用智能将占主导。

agi-timeline.en: AGI might arrive by 2030, contradicting widespread skepticism about rapid timelines.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）可能在 2030 年前到来，这违背了对快速时间表的普遍怀疑。

agi-timeline.en: Superintelligence likely arrives by 2029-2030, transforming everything.
agi-timeline.zh: 超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，彻底改变一切。

agi-timeline.en: We are as close to superhuman AI now as in the 1970s; progress is not accelerating.
agi-timeline.zh: 我们现在离超人 AI 的距离与 1970 年代一样；进展并未加速。

agi-timeline.en: The singularity is a wrong-headed idea because intelligence is multifaceted and context-dependent.
agi-timeline.zh: 奇点是一个错误的想法，因为智能是多方面的且依赖于上下文。

agi-timeline.en: AI has clear ROI; denial of model progress is a common misconception despite continuous capability improvements.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 有明确回报；否认模型进步是常见误解，尽管能力持续提升。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is approaching; models will soon do end-to-end research.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 正在逼近；模型很快将能进行端到端研究。

agi-timeline.en: Superintelligence is not inevitable; we can choose to build beneficial AI rather than human-like entities.
agi-timeline.zh: 超级智能并非不可避免；我们可以选择构建有益的 AI，而非类人实体。

agi-timeline.en: The S-curve of AI is early; we don't even know the right questions yet.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 的 S 曲线尚处早期；我们甚至还没问对问题。

agi-timeline.en: The path to AGI involves general-purpose systems that learn from diverse inputs.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 的路径涉及从多样化输入中学习的通用系统。

agi-timeline.en: DeepMind's early game work was a means to AGI, not an end in itself.
agi-timeline.zh: DeepMind 早期的游戏工作是实现 AGI 的手段，而非目的本身。

agi-timeline.en: AGI may not be a single entity but a distributed society of specialized agents.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 可能不是单一实体，而是由专业智能体组成的分布式社会。

agi-timeline.en: Models improve faster than people expect; underestimate them.
agi-timeline.zh: 模型改进速度超出预期；人们低估了它们。

agi-timeline.en: Capability overhang means models are capable before adoption.
agi-timeline.zh: 能力过剩意味着模型在被采用之前就已具备能力。

agi-timeline.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, and it's more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
agi-timeline.zh: 编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，它比等待通用 AGI 更具影响力。

agi-timeline.en: Curing all diseases by end of century is now seen as too conservative.
agi-timeline.zh: 在本世纪末治愈所有疾病的目标现在被认为过于保守。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is a meaningless term; human intelligence is specialized and adaptive, not general.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 是无意义的术语；人类智能是专门化且自适应的，而非通用的。

agi-timeline.en: The singularity is decades away and too speculative; focus on near-term progress.
agi-timeline.zh: 奇点还需数十年，过于推测；应关注近期进展。

agi-timeline.en: AI progress in math follows a trajectory of solving problems with longer human time horizons.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 在数学上的进步遵循解决需要人类更长时间的问题的轨迹。

agi-timeline.en: Competition math may soon be saturated; real research is the new frontier.
agi-timeline.zh: 竞赛数学可能很快饱和；真正的研究才是新前沿。

agi-timeline.en: AI can now solve major open math problems, like disproving an Erdős conjecture.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 现在能解决重大数学开放问题，比如推翻一个 Erdős 猜想。

agi-timeline.en: AI solved a major math problem faster than most researchers expected.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 解决重大数学问题的速度比多数研究者预期的更快。

agi-timeline.en: AI progress is faster than expected; superintelligence likely within 20 years.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 进展比预期更快；超级智能可能在 20 年内出现。

agi-timeline.en: The concept of AGI as human-level at all tasks simultaneously is flawed; AI is jagged.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 在所有任务上同时达到人类水平的概念有缺陷；AI 的能力是不均衡的。

agi-timeline.en: Predicting AI's future beyond a few years is like seeing through exponential fog.
agi-timeline.zh: 预测 AI 几年后的未来就像透过指数级迷雾看东西。

agi-timeline.en: We should not replicate human intelligence but create a new form that understands human needs.
agi-timeline.zh: 我们不应复制人类智能，而应创造一种理解人类需求的新智能形式。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is a direction of progress, not a final destination; real challenge is practical integration.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 是进步的方向而非最终目标；真正的挑战在于实际整合。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is a messy, concrete direction requiring understanding of physics and human behavior.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 是一个混乱而具体的方向，需要理解物理和人类行为。

agi-timeline.en: Intelligence explosion may not happen soon; tools like superhuman coders are just new microscopes.
agi-timeline.zh: 智能爆炸可能不会很快发生；像超人编码器这样的工具只是新显微镜。

agi-timeline.en: AGI may already be here by some definitions; the goalposts keep moving.
agi-timeline.zh: 根据某些定义，AGI 可能已经到来；目标不断后移。

agi-timeline.en: Current AI hype distracts from real problems like healthcare and transportation.
agi-timeline.zh: 当前的 AI 炒作分散了对医疗和交通等实际问题的关注。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is a PR term that distorts research and demoralizes young people.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 是一个公关术语，扭曲了研究并让年轻人感到沮丧。

agi-timeline.en: Intelligence is hard to define; writing a thought-provoking novel is a good proxy for AGI.
agi-timeline.zh: 智能很难定义；写一本发人深省的小说是 AGI 的一个好代理指标。

agi-timeline.en: AI is progressing slower than most AI researchers think; the impact is only now reaching the business world.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 的进展比大多数 AI 研究者认为的要慢；其影响现在才刚开始触及商业世界。

agi-timeline.en: AI progress will take longer than AI optimists think but shorter than doctors expect.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 的进展会比 AI 乐观主义者认为的更慢，但比医生预期的更快。

agi-timeline.en: The key to success is solving the intelligence problem, not just manufacturing, for humanoid robots.
agi-timeline.zh: 成功的关键在于解决智能问题，而不仅仅是制造问题，对于人形机器人而言。

agi-timeline.en: Figure aims to ship robots at scale this year and solve general robotics, achieving AGI in the physical world.
agi-timeline.zh: Figure 的目标是今年大规模出货机器人，并解决通用机器人问题，在物理世界实现 AGI。

agi-timeline.en: OpenAI focuses on a singular vision: building an AGI you can talk to, with context, trustworthy.
agi-timeline.zh: OpenAI 专注于单一愿景：构建一个你可以与之对话、有上下文、值得信赖的 AGI。

agi-timeline.en: We are about 80% to AGI; models are already smarter than humans at writing software with context.
agi-timeline.zh: 我们大约 80%接近 AGI；在有上下文的情况下，模型在编写软件方面已经比人类更聪明。

agi-timeline.en: AI models can now solve unsolved math problems individually, traditionally requiring a team.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 模型现在可以单独解决未解决的数学问题，而传统上需要一个团队。

agi-timeline.en: The middle-term timeline for home robots is highly uncertain; even experts disagree.
agi-timeline.zh: 家用机器人的中期时间线高度不确定；即使是专家也意见不一。

agi-timeline.en: Humans are optimistic in the short term and pessimistic in the long term, but robotics progress surprises even experts.
agi-timeline.zh: 人类在短期内乐观，长期悲观，但机器人技术的进展甚至让专家感到惊讶。

agi-timeline.en: AGI may already be achieved if defined as creating a billion-dollar company, as AI agents can now build viral web services.
agi-timeline.zh: 如果 AGI 定义为创建十亿美元公司，那么它可能已经实现，因为 AI 智能体现在可以构建病毒式网络服务。

agi-timeline.en: Fast AI timelines favor the US; slow timelines favor China due to supply chain indigenization.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 快速发展有利于美国；缓慢发展则因供应链自主化而有利于中国。

agi-timeline.en: LLMs are a dead end for achieving human-level AI.
agi-timeline.zh: 大语言模型是实现人类级 AI 的死胡同。

agi-timeline.en: Move 37 showed AI can produce insights beyond human knowledge.
agi-timeline.zh: 第 37 手表明 AI 能产生超越人类知识的洞见。

agi-timeline.en: AlphaGo marked a transition point where AI surpassed human intelligence in specific areas.
agi-timeline.zh: AlphaGo 标志着 AI 在特定领域超越人类智能的转折点。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is vastly overhyped; we are decades away from human-like general intelligence.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 被严重夸大；我们距离类人通用智能还有数十年。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is a marketing term; the public's definition is far from technical reality.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 是营销术语；公众的定义远非技术现实。

agi-timeline.en: AI models are approaching human-level intelligence, but society lacks awareness.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 模型正接近人类智能水平，但社会缺乏认知。

agi-timeline.en: The path to AGI is progressive, not a single event or discovery.
agi-timeline.zh: 通往 AGI 的道路是渐进的，而非单一事件或发现。

agi-timeline.en: Political leaders must treat AI as an immediate priority, not a tomorrow issue.
agi-timeline.zh: 政治领袖必须将 AI 视为当务之急，而非明日议题。

agi-timeline.en: AI capabilities are doubling every 7 months, reaching human-level in ~5 years.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 能力每 7 个月翻一番，约 5 年内达到人类水平。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is not a single moment; we should track specific capabilities instead.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 并非单一时刻，应追踪具体能力而非等待奇点。

agi-timeline.en: I'm 90% confident we'll get a 'country of geniuses in a data center' within 10 years, and 50% within 1-3 years.
agi-timeline.zh: 我 90%确信 10 年内会实现「数据中心里的天才之国」，50%概率在 1-3 年内。

agi-timeline.en: A country of geniuses in a data center could arrive in 1-3 years, not 10.
agi-timeline.zh: 数据中心里的天才之国可能在 1-3 年内到来，而非 10 年。

agi-timeline.en: There will be billions of digital minds, not one winner in AI.
agi-timeline.zh: 将会有数十亿数字心智，而非单一赢家。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is a fuzzy concept; focus on artificial capable intelligence and modern Turing test.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 概念模糊；应关注人工能力智能和现代图灵测试。

agi-timeline.en: The physical Turing test—a robot cleaning a messy house—is the grand challenge for embodied AI.
agi-timeline.zh: 物理图灵测试——机器人打扫凌乱的房子——是具身 AI 的巨大挑战。

agi-timeline.en: The GPT-3 moment for robotics will happen in about five years, but home use will take longer due to safety and unstructured environments.
agi-timeline.zh: 机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻大约在五年后到来，但家庭应用由于安全和非结构化环境需要更长时间。

agi-timeline.en: A software-only singularity is possible where digital tasks advance rapidly while physical world lags.
agi-timeline.zh: 可能出现仅软件的奇点，数字任务快速进步而物理世界滞后。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 并非单一事件；人类水平只是通往超人能力的注脚。

agi-timeline.en: Current models lack the ability to self-correct from failures, a key missing piece for AGI.
agi-timeline.zh: 当前模型缺乏从失败中自我修正的能力，这是实现 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键缺失环节。

agi-timeline.en: AGI hype misleads business leaders and students; real AGI is far off and requires new breakthroughs.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 炒作误导商业领袖和学生；真正的 AGI 还很遥远，需要新的突破。

agi-timeline.en: AGI as a single system solving all problems will never exist.
agi-timeline.zh: 能解决所有问题的单一 AGI 系统永远不会存在。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is a spectrum, not a single threshold; minimal AGI means matching typical human cognitive abilities.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 是一个谱系，而非单一阈值；最小 AGI 意味着匹配典型人类认知能力。

agi-timeline.en: Current AI shows uneven capabilities: superhuman in language and knowledge, but weak in reasoning and continual learning.
agi-timeline.zh: 当前 AI 能力不均衡：在语言和知识上超人类，但在推理和持续学习上薄弱。

agi-timeline.en: Shane Legg maintains a 50% chance of minimal AGI by 2028, with full AGI within a decade.
agi-timeline.zh: Shane Legg 坚持认为到 2028 年有 50%的概率实现最小 AGI，完全 AGI 在十年内。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is likely a decade or more away, not just a few years, due to the difficulty of moving from 80% to 99.9% performance.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 可能还需要十年或更长时间，而不是几年，因为从 80%到 99.9%的性能提升非常困难。

agi-timeline.en: AI progress will be gradual, not a sudden superintelligence event.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 进步将是渐进的，而非突然的超级智能事件。

agi-timeline.en: Transformative long-running AI is closer than expected, with building blocks already in place.
agi-timeline.zh: 变革性的长期运行 AI 比预期更近，基础模块已经就位。

agi-timeline.en: AI is underhyped; perception caught up with usage after ChatGPT.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 被低估了；ChatGPT 后认知才赶上实际使用。

agi-timeline.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally, not a finished AGI that knows everything.
agi-timeline.zh: 超级智能应是一个持续学习者，逐步部署，而非无所不知的成品 AGI。

agi-timeline.en: The term AGI overshoots; humans are not AGI but rely on continual learning.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 这个词过度了；人类并非 AGI，而是依赖持续学习。

agi-timeline.en: AI is a civilizational technology that will impact everyone's life, work, and well-being.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 是一项文明级技术，将影响每个人的生活、工作和福祉。

agi-timeline.en: AGI will arrive via messy co-evolution, not a sudden singularity; progress is smooth but constrained.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 将通过混乱的共同进化到来，而非突然的奇点；进步是平稳但受限的。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）更多是营销术语而非科学术语。

agi-timeline.en: AI today cannot match a toddler in counting chairs or Newton in deriving laws.
agi-timeline.zh: 当今 AI 在数椅子或推导牛顿定律上还不如幼儿或牛顿。

agi-timeline.en: AI progress is jagged; different tasks improve at different rates.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 进步是参差不齐的；不同任务以不同速度提升。

agi-timeline.en: Digital tasks with abundant data see fastest AI improvement.
agi-timeline.zh: 数据丰富的数字任务中 AI 进步最快。

agi-timeline.en: Fast superintelligence takeoff is unlikely; improvement is gradual per task.
agi-timeline.zh: 快速超级智能起飞不太可能；改进是逐任务渐进的。

agi-timeline.en: AI progress is continuous with computing automation, not a discrete explosion.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 进步与计算自动化是连续的，而非离散的爆发。

agi-timeline.en: Despite claims of a plateau, AI progress is accelerating, not slowing down.
agi-timeline.zh: 尽管有人声称平台期到来，但 AI 进步正在加速，而非放缓。

agi-timeline.en: AI succession to digital intelligence is inevitable due to lack of global consensus and pursuit of superintelligence.
agi-timeline.zh: 由于缺乏全球共识和对超级智能的追求，AI 向数字智能的接替不可避免。

agi-timeline.en: Intellectual humility about AGI timelines is crucial; act as if AGI could come soon.
agi-timeline.zh: 对 AGI 时间线保持智力谦逊至关重要；假设 AGI 可能很快到来。

agi-timeline.en: People are overconfident about their AGI timelines and p(doom); refuse to answer publicly.
agi-timeline.zh: 人们对 AGI 时间线和末日概率过于自信；拒绝公开回答。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑，而非单一事件。

agi-timeline.en: The term AGI is becoming meaningless, which may mean we are close.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 一词正变得无意义，这可能意味着我们已接近。

agi-timeline.en: 50th percentile chance of superintelligence by 2028, based on exponential progress and scaling laws.
agi-timeline.zh: 到 2028 年出现超级智能的概率为 50%，基于指数级进步和缩放定律。

agi-timeline.en: A good definition of AGI is when it becomes economically profitable to run agents indefinitely without human intervention.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 的一个好的定义是，当无限期运行智能体在经济上变得有利可图且无需人工干预时。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is defined by economic profitability of running agents indefinitely, not by passing tests like the Turing test.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 的定义是无限期运行智能体的经济盈利能力，而不是通过图灵测试等测试。

agi-timeline.en: AI models are advancing faster than expected, with coding benchmarks and agentic capabilities scaling as predicted.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 模型的发展速度超出预期，编码基准和智能体能力正按预测扩展。

agi-timeline.en: Robotics progress has shifted from decades to 5-10 years.
agi-timeline.zh: 机器人技术的进展已从几十年缩短到 5-10 年。

agi-timeline.en: Coding is the leading indicator for AI progress and will accelerate AI research.
agi-timeline.zh: 编程是 AI 进展的领先指标，并将加速 AI 研究。

agi-timeline.en: A GPT-3 moment in biology will look like AlphaGo's Move 37, not human-like text.
agi-timeline.zh: 生物学中的 GPT-3 时刻将更像 AlphaGo 的第 37 手，而非类人文本。

agi-timeline.en: The ARC AGI benchmark is overhyped; progress there doesn't reflect real AGI progress.
agi-timeline.zh: ARC AGI 基准被过度炒作；其进展不代表真正的 AGI 进展。

agi-timeline.en: Digital AGI will arrive much earlier than embodied AGI due to controlled environments.
agi-timeline.zh: 由于环境可控，数字 AGI 将比具身 AGI 更早到来。

agi-timeline.en: LLMs haven't had their AlphaZero moment yet; it may come in 5 years.
agi-timeline.zh: LLM 尚未迎来它们的 AlphaZero 时刻；可能在未来 5 年内到来。

agi-timeline.en: The grand theme of the 21st century is true AI, which will change civilization completely and lead to an AI explosion.
agi-timeline.zh: 21 世纪的主题是真正的 AI，它将彻底改变文明并引发 AI 爆炸。

agi-timeline.en: Large language models like ChatGPT are far from AGI; they index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world.
agi-timeline.zh: 像 ChatGPT 这样的大语言模型远非 AGI；它们索引人类知识，但无法处理物理世界。

agi-timeline.en: AGI will likely arrive within 4-50 years, much sooner than academia traditionally expects.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 可能在 4 到 50 年内到来，比学术界传统预期快得多。

agi-timeline.en: AI will be a fundamental technology shift, similar to the creation of computing.
agi-timeline.zh: AI 将是一次根本性的技术变革，类似于计算的诞生。

agi-timeline.en: The four-year timeline is ambitious but chosen to force rapid progress, not because AGI is expected then.
agi-timeline.zh: 四年时间表虽然雄心勃勃，但选择它是为了推动快速进展，而不是因为预计那时会出现 AGI。

agi-timeline.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI 将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发。

agi-timeline.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
agi-timeline.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 是模式识别，而非通用智能。

scaling.en: AI demand is surging, driving record revenue and a global infrastructure buildout.
scaling.zh: AI 需求激增，推动创纪录的营收和全球基础设施建设。

scaling.en: NVIDIA's full-stack AI factory platform captures more data center TAM per gigawatt.
scaling.zh: NVIDIA 的全栈 AI 工厂平台每吉瓦捕获更多数据中心 TAM。

scaling.en: Supply constraints limit growth to 70% despite demand exceeding 100%.
scaling.zh: 尽管需求超过 100%，供应限制使增长仅为 70%。

scaling.en: Compute is centralizing rapidly at frontier labs, with OpenAI and Anthropic taking 40-50% of new compute next year.
scaling.zh: 算力正在快速向前沿实验室集中，OpenAI 和 Anthropic 明年将占据新增算力的 40-50%。

scaling.en: China's compute growth is constrained by export controls, but will hockey stick in 2028-2029.
scaling.zh: 中国的算力增长受出口管制制约，但将在 2028-2029 年出现爆发式增长。

scaling.en: Labs will reduce inference compute share over time, contrary to the common belief that most compute goes to inference.
scaling.zh: 实验室将逐渐减少推理算力占比，这与主流认为大部分算力用于推理的观点相反。

scaling.en: Robotics is at the stage of establishing fundamental scalable technologies, not yet at predictable scaling curves like LLMs.
scaling.zh: 机器人技术正处于建立可扩展基础技术的阶段，尚未达到像大语言模型那样可预测的缩放曲线。

scaling.en: A data flywheel where deployed robots improve model capability is key, but you must scale the right thing with diverse data.
scaling.zh: 部署的机器人提升模型能力的数据飞轮是关键，但必须用多样化的数据扩展正确的事物。

scaling.en: Even for specialized tasks like warehouse automation, training on a breadth of data yields better performance.
scaling.zh: 即使对于仓库自动化等专门任务，在广泛数据上训练也能获得更好的性能。

scaling.en: The most important thing for OpenAI is to build smart models and run them efficiently and abundantly.
scaling.zh: 对 OpenAI 来说，最重要的是构建智能模型，并高效、大量地运行它们。

scaling.en: Scaling up deep learning models has consistently yielded major improvements across AI fields, unifying previously separate disciplines.
scaling.zh: 扩大深度学习模型的规模持续在 AI 各领域带来重大改进，统一了以往相互独立的学科。

scaling.en: AI will transform scientific discovery, and the government must adapt its R&D funding accordingly.
scaling.zh: AI 将改变科学发现的方式，政府必须相应调整其研发资助策略。

scaling.en: The US government's role in R&D funding has inverted; private sector now dominates, requiring a new approach.
scaling.zh: 美国政府在研发资助中的角色已经反转；私营部门现在占主导，需要新的方法。

scaling.en: Only 20-30 people in California truly know how to build good AI models.
scaling.zh: 加州真正懂得构建优秀 AI 模型的人只有 20 到 30 人。

scaling.en: Diverse data and detailed prompting are crucial for compositional generalization in robotics.
scaling.zh: 多样化的数据和详细的提示对于机器人领域的组合泛化至关重要。

scaling.en: Starting with a generalist policy and fine-tuning is often more effective than training per-site models from scratch.
scaling.zh: 从通用策略开始并进行微调通常比从头训练每个站点的模型更有效。

scaling.en: Data quality matters more than quantity; product teams are the best judges of data quality for their specific use cases.
scaling.zh: 数据质量比数量更重要；产品团队是特定用例数据质量的最佳评判者。

scaling.en: Data is a key differentiator for AI strategy, alongside compute and algorithms.
scaling.zh: 数据与算力和算法一样，是 AI 战略的关键差异化因素。

scaling.en: Validation of protein designs remains a bottleneck, but improvements in wet-lab turnaround times are enabling faster iteration.
scaling.zh: 蛋白质设计的验证仍是瓶颈，但湿实验室周转时间的改善使得更快的迭代成为可能。

scaling.en: The compute market is heavily optimized for LLMs, requiring startups like Chai to invest in custom optimizations for structural biology models.
scaling.zh: 算力市场高度优化于 LLM，像 Chai 这样的初创公司需要投资于结构生物学模型的定制优化。

scaling.en: The biggest bottleneck in AI for biology is not model architecture but the lack of standardized data formats and engineering infrastructure.
scaling.zh: AI 在生物学中的最大瓶颈不是模型架构，而是缺乏标准化的数据格式和工程基础设施。

scaling.en: The cost of token has not increased despite scaling because labs prioritize faster iteration over larger models.
scaling.zh: 尽管规模扩张，但 token 成本并未增加，因为实验室优先考虑更快迭代而非更大模型。

scaling.en: Starship is the hardest thing humanity has ever tried, enabling millions of tons to orbit annually.
scaling.zh: 星舰是人类尝试过的最困难的事情，每年可向轨道运送数百万吨。

scaling.en: Starlink may eventually carry over 90% of all internet traffic.
scaling.zh: 星链最终可能承载超过 90%的互联网流量。

scaling.en: AI traffic will be a thousand times more than human internet traffic in five years.
scaling.zh: 五年内，AI 流量将是人类互联网流量的千倍。

scaling.en: Scaling laws for language models can be derived from the correlation structure and entropy of text.
scaling.zh: 语言模型的缩放定律可以从文本的相关性结构和熵中推导出来。

scaling.en: Scaling up current models may not lead to true scientific creativity; we need new abilities beyond next-token prediction.
scaling.zh: 仅仅扩大当前模型的规模可能无法实现真正的科学创造力；我们需要超越下一个词预测的新能力。

scaling.en: Caching is critical for cost; maintaining high cache rates (85%) is essential for economic viability.
scaling.zh: 缓存对成本至关重要；维持高缓存率（85%）对经济可行性至关重要。

scaling.en: Modern AI's success stems from the convergence of neural networks, big data, and GPU computing, as exemplified by ImageNet.
scaling.zh: 现代人工智能的成功源于神经网络、大数据和 GPU 算力的融合，ImageNet 就是例证。

scaling.en: Inference providers are crucial for hosting open-weight models, often outperforming hyperscalers in speed and uptime.
scaling.zh: 推理提供商对于托管开放权重模型至关重要，通常在速度和正常运行时间上优于超大规模云服务商。

scaling.en: Inference providers are not commoditized; they innovate and differentiate, making tokens more efficient.
scaling.zh: 推理提供商并未商品化；它们创新并差异化，使代币更高效。

scaling.en: Pacing the frontier requires simple, enforceable rules like compute limits, not complex technical mandates.
scaling.zh: 前沿节奏需要简单可执行的规则，如算力限制，而非复杂的技术指令。

scaling.en: Scaling laws are crucial; identify them to guide investment in data, models, and compute.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律至关重要；识别它们以指导数据、模型和算力的投资。

scaling.en: Data compounds: better models generate more data, enabling further improvement.
scaling.zh: 数据复合：更好的模型生成更多数据，从而实现进一步改进。

scaling.en: Simplicity is a guiding principle; complex models with many submodules are hard to scale.
scaling.zh: 简单性是指导原则；具有许多子模块的复杂模型难以扩展。

scaling.en: Structure that fights scale always loses; structure that channels scale always wins.
scaling.zh: 对抗规模的结构总是失败；引导规模的结构总是胜利。

scaling.en: Data strategy is crucial for AI companies; collecting behavioral and experimental data is key.
scaling.zh: 数据策略对 AI 公司至关重要；收集行为数据和实验数据是关键。

scaling.en: Simulation can unlock testing of hypotheses that are currently impossible due to scale or cost.
scaling.zh: 模拟可以解锁当前因规模或成本而无法进行的假设测试。

scaling.en: Synthetic panels will surpass human panels in size within three years.
scaling.zh: 合成面板将在三年内超过人类面板的规模。

scaling.en: The biggest bottleneck for AI progress is not data or compute, but new ideas for handling long time horizons and non-verifiable rewards.
scaling.zh: AI 进步的最大瓶颈不是数据或算力，而是处理长时间跨度和不可验证奖励的新思路。

scaling.en: Specialized hardware for inference, with low precision and low data movement, is key to scaling agent systems.
scaling.zh: 面向推理的专用硬件，采用低精度和低数据移动，是扩展智能体系统的关键。

scaling.en: Most so-called model limitations are actually energy and data-IO bottlenecks; data movement costs about 1000x more than compute.
scaling.zh: 大多数所谓模型限制实际上是能量和数据 IO 瓶颈；数据移动的能耗约是计算的 1000 倍。

scaling.en: Most architectural research is done at too small a scale; large compute is needed to see potential.
scaling.zh: 大多数架构研究的规模太小；需要大量算力才能看到潜力。

scaling.en: Frontier AI is research; labs need talent density and operating models that compound with exponential growth.
scaling.zh: 前沿 AI 是研究工作；实验室需要人才密度和能与指数增长复利的运营模式。

scaling.en: Even if model progress froze, diffusion alone would drive decades of upheaval; capabilities are not the bottleneck.
scaling.zh: 即使模型进步停滞，仅凭技术扩散就会带来几十年的巨变；能力本身不是瓶颈。

scaling.en: Building more data centers and increasing inference capacity is crucial for AI progress and American competitiveness.
scaling.zh: 建设更多数据中心和增加推理能力对于 AI 进展和美国竞争力至关重要。

scaling.en: The value of AI applications built on top of infrastructure will surpass the infrastructure itself.
scaling.zh: 建立在基础设施之上的 AI 应用的价值将超过基础设施本身。

scaling.en: Data centers are more environmentally efficient than distributed computing, making them a positive force.
scaling.zh: 数据中心比分布式计算更环保，因此是积极的力量。

scaling.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, enabling counterfactual reasoning and systematic coverage of state space.
scaling.zh: 仿真对机器人至关重要，能够实现反事实推理和状态空间的系统覆盖。

scaling.en: Robotics lacks data; simulation scales data generation for training and evaluation.
scaling.zh: 机器人领域缺乏数据；仿真可规模化生成用于训练和评估的数据。

scaling.en: Compute demand is uncapped at low price; huge infrastructure investment needed.
scaling.zh: 低价下算力需求无上限；需要巨额基础设施投资。

scaling.en: Frontier model improvement is exponential; staying on frontier is key.
scaling.zh: 前沿模型改进呈指数级；保持领先是关键。

scaling.en: The token max era lasted only from January to May 2026.
scaling.zh: 令牌最大化时代仅从 2026 年 1 月持续到 5 月。

scaling.en: The real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
scaling.zh: 真正的解锁在于容量，而非效率。

scaling.en: Scaling weight space learning requires diverse model zoos, not just more models.
scaling.zh: 扩展权重空间学习需要多样化的模型库，而不仅仅是更多模型。

scaling.en: Instead of running out of data, we should reuse weights of existing models as a new data source.
scaling.zh: 与其说数据枯竭，不如复用现有模型的权重作为新数据源。

scaling.en: Coding became a key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption.
scaling.zh: 编码成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动了采用率。

scaling.en: Exponential model growth demands adaptability and first-principles thinking.
scaling.zh: 模型的指数级增长要求适应性和第一性原理思考。

scaling.en: Maximizing token spend is living in the future and capturing alpha.
scaling.zh: 最大化令牌消耗就是活在未来并获取超额收益。

scaling.en: Scaling autonomy shifts from model capability to operational complexity, edge cases, and hardware manufacturing.
scaling.zh: 规模化自动驾驶的挑战从模型能力转向运营复杂度、边缘案例和硬件制造。

scaling.en: Hardware became the bottleneck, not a commodity; supply chain and manufacturing are now the hardest problems.
scaling.zh: 硬件不再是商品，反而成了瓶颈；供应链和制造现在是最大的难题。

scaling.en: Inference speed—tokens per second per user—is now the dominant metric for AI productivity.
scaling.zh: 推理速度——每秒每用户令牌数——现在是 AI 生产力的主导指标。

scaling.en: Major bottlenecks are HBM memory, CoWoS packaging, and 3nm fab capacity—not just compute.
scaling.zh: 主要瓶颈是 HBM 内存、CoWoS 封装和 3 纳米工厂产能——不仅仅是算力。

scaling.en: AI demand is real and outstrips supply; the industry is chasing existing demand, not building speculative capacity.
scaling.zh: AI 需求真实且超过供给；行业在追逐已有需求，而非建设投机性产能。

scaling.en: AI investments are redefining every part of Alphabet's business, driving 24% revenue growth.
scaling.zh: AI 投资正在重新定义 Alphabet 业务的每个部分，推动收入增长 24%。

scaling.en: Google Cloud revenue grew 82% with backlog reaching $514 billion, driven by enterprise AI demand.
scaling.zh: Google Cloud 收入增长 82%，积压订单达 5140 亿美元，受企业 AI 需求驱动。

scaling.en: Gemini models are deeply integrated across Search, Cloud, and YouTube, improving monetization and user experience.
scaling.zh: Gemini 模型深度集成到搜索、云和 YouTube 中，改善了变现和用户体验。

scaling.en: Model building is fundamentally engineering, mostly improving data and compute efficiency rather than solving math theorems.
scaling.zh: 模型构建本质上是一门工程，主要在于改进数据和算力效率，而不是证明数学定理。

scaling.en: Persistent, self-verifying behavior can make smaller models outperform much larger ones, so we can squeeze far more from existing sizes.
scaling.zh: 具备持久验证行为的小模型可以超越大得多的模型，因此我们能从现有规模中榨出更多性能。

scaling.en: The peak of useful model size for most knowledge work may be near one trillion parameters, not several orders of magnitude larger.
scaling.zh: 对大多数知识工作有用的模型规模峰值可能接近一万亿参数，而不是再大几个数量级。

scaling.en: Virtual cell models require causal perturbation data, not just observational data, to predict drug responses.
scaling.zh: 虚拟细胞模型需要因果扰动数据，而不仅仅是观察性数据，才能预测药物反应。

scaling.en: High-quality, large-scale perturbation datasets are the most critical factor for model performance.
scaling.zh: 高质量、大规模的扰动数据集是模型性能最关键的因素。

scaling.en: Foundation models trained on observational data often fail to beat linear baselines on perturbation tasks.
scaling.zh: 在观察性数据上训练的基础模型在扰动任务上往往无法超越线性基线。

scaling.en: Token usage will shift from synchronous to 90% asynchronous within 12-24 months.
scaling.zh: 代币使用将在 12-24 个月内从同步转向 90%异步。

scaling.en: Data collection and safety validation are the main bottlenecks in physical AI, not the underlying algorithms.
scaling.zh: 数据收集和安全验证是物理 AI 的主要瓶颈，而不是底层算法。

scaling.en: Hardware depreciation cycles are accelerating, making build vs. buy decisions timing-dependent.
scaling.zh: 硬件折旧周期加速，使自建与购买决策取决于时机。

scaling.en: Claude Code's growth is driven by model improvements, not just the harness.
scaling.zh: Claude Code 的增长主要由模型改进驱动，而不仅仅是工具本身。

scaling.en: The biggest moats in business are not switching costs but scale and network effects.
scaling.zh: 商业中最大的护城河不是转换成本，而是规模效应和网络效应。

scaling.en: The bitter lesson and scaling are key: general methods that scale beat specialized ones.
scaling.zh: 苦涩教训和 Scaling（规模扩张）是关键：可扩展的通用方法胜过专用方法。

scaling.en: The internet data is exhausted; the next scaling axis is experimentally generated data.
scaling.zh: 互联网数据已耗尽；下一个 Scaling（规模扩张）轴是实验生成的数据。

scaling.en: Compute demand far outstrips supply; any new compute is consumed immediately.
scaling.zh: 算力需求远超供给；任何新增算力都会被立即消耗。

scaling.en: Inference is the dominant compute workload, even during training due to synthetic data and post-training.
scaling.zh: 推理是主要的算力负载，即使在训练阶段也因合成数据和后训练而占主导。

scaling.en: The biggest worry is not overbuilding but underbuilding compute due to physical world constraints.
scaling.zh: 最大的担忧不是过度建设，而是因物理世界限制导致算力建设不足。

scaling.en: Scaling alone faces diminishing returns; new techniques like reasoning and search are needed for further progress.
scaling.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 面临收益递减；需要推理和搜索等新技术来取得进一步进展。

scaling.en: The web is a one-time data source; there is no second internet of higher knowledge to scale on.
scaling.zh: 网络是一次性数据源；没有第二个更高级知识的互联网可供 Scaling。

scaling.en: Future enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens, requiring training-based compression.
scaling.zh: 未来企业数据将达到互联网规模的数万亿 token，需要基于训练的压缩方法。

scaling.en: Scaling with more compute is not the only path; the next paradigm requires doing more with less.
scaling.zh: 增加算力的 Scaling 并非唯一路径；下一范式需要以更少做更多。

scaling.en: Chronological feeds fail at scale; algorithmic feeds increase satisfaction despite user complaints.
scaling.zh: 按时间排序的推送在大规模下失败；算法推送尽管有用户抱怨，但提高了满意度。

scaling.en: The bottleneck in AI is no longer capability but interface; current interfaces lag behind model capabilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
scaling.zh: AI 的瓶颈不再是能力而是界面；当前界面落后于模型能力，尤其是在非编码任务方面。

scaling.en: AI's exponential growth shows no signs of slowing, contrary to expectations of a plateau.
scaling.zh: AI 的指数级增长没有放缓迹象，这与预期中的平台期相反。

scaling.en: Elastic inference for custom models is Modal's biggest use case, with unpredictable traffic patterns.
scaling.zh: 为定制模型提供的弹性推理是 Modal 最大的用例，其流量模式不可预测。

scaling.en: Auto-scaling and GPU snapshotting are key differentiators for Modal's inference platform.
scaling.zh: 自动扩缩容和 GPU 快照是 Modal 推理平台的关键差异化优势。

scaling.en: Modal does not own data centers; being capital-light on software allows faster iteration.
scaling.zh: Modal 不拥有数据中心；在软件上保持轻资产可以更快地迭代。

scaling.en: Building olfactory AI requires massive, purpose-built datasets; scraping the internet is insufficient.
scaling.zh: 构建嗅觉 AI 需要大规模、专门构建的数据集；抓取互联网是不够的。

scaling.en: Scaling to a million deliveries a day requires rethinking all systems.
scaling.zh: 扩展到每天百万次配送需要重新思考所有系统。

scaling.en: Solar weather, not just wind, is a major challenge for drone navigation.
scaling.zh: 太阳天气，而不仅仅是风，是无人机导航的主要挑战。

scaling.en: The US air traffic control system is outdated and needs transformation.
scaling.zh: 美国空中交通管制系统过时，需要转型。

scaling.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive scaling needed.
scaling.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统；需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）。

scaling.en: Scaling compute and data yields predictable improvements in AI capabilities.
scaling.zh: 扩展算力和数据能带来 AI 能力的可预测提升。

scaling.en: Scaling alone, without new ideas, can still lead to major breakthroughs.
scaling.zh: 仅靠扩展规模，即使没有新想法，也能带来重大突破。

scaling.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity often mislead; evaluating on real downstream tasks and hardware is essential.
scaling.zh: 困惑度等代理指标常误导；在真实下游任务和硬件上评估至关重要。

scaling.en: Scaling laws show that unstructured architectures like transformers dominate at large scale, not biased ones.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律表明，无偏架构（如 Transformer）在大规模下占优，而非有偏架构。

scaling.en: Inference compute will increase 90,000x in 24-36 months, making AI capabilities surge.
scaling.zh: 推理算力将在 24-36 个月内增长 9 万倍，推动 AI 能力激增。

scaling.en: Nvidia may be vastly underpriced, not overpriced, by several orders of magnitude.
scaling.zh: 英伟达可能被严重低估，而非高估，低估了几个数量级。

scaling.en: Efficiency is key to getting more intelligence when running at compute or power limits.
scaling.zh: 在算力或功耗受限时，效率是获得更多智能的关键。

scaling.en: Pre-training in 4-bit arithmetic is feasible and yields efficiency gains despite numerical challenges.
scaling.zh: 尽管存在数值挑战，但使用 4 位算术进行预训练是可行的，并能带来效率提升。

scaling.en: Scaling laws continue to hold; no wall in sight despite decades of predictions.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律持续有效；尽管数十年间屡有预测，但尚未触及天花板。

scaling.en: Compute will remain the scarce resource; demand will far outstrip supply.
scaling.zh: 算力仍将是稀缺资源；需求将远超供给。

scaling.en: Scaling in drug discovery AI mirrors LLM scaling: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time scaling all matter.
scaling.zh: 药物发现 AI 的 Scaling（规模扩张）模仿 LLM 的 Scaling（规模扩张）：预训练、后训练和推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）都很重要。

scaling.en: Synthetic data from physics-based simulations is key to augment limited experimental data for training models.
scaling.zh: 基于物理的模拟生成的合成数据是扩充有限实验数据以训练模型的关键。

scaling.en: GPU shortage is a major bottleneck for drug discovery AI, not just for LLMs.
scaling.zh: GPU 短缺是药物发现 AI 的主要瓶颈，而不仅仅是 LLM。

scaling.en: Hardware is slow; AI improvements will make glasses more useful over time.
scaling.zh: 硬件发展缓慢；AI 的进步将随时间让眼镜更有用。

scaling.en: Model capability is now a function of test-time compute budget, not just model weights.
scaling.zh: 模型能力现在是测试时算力预算的函数，而不仅仅是模型权重。

scaling.en: Benchmarks must be evaluated with an x-axis of tokens, cost, or time to compare models fairly.
scaling.zh: 基准测试必须用词元、成本或时间作为 x 轴来公平比较模型。

scaling.en: Models improve continuously with more test-time compute on many tasks, without plateauing.
scaling.zh: 在许多任务上，模型随着测试时算力增加而持续改进，不会饱和。

scaling.en: Scaling laws still hold; pre-training is not dead.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律仍然成立；预训练并未消亡。

scaling.en: Pre-training is not dead; scaling continues despite repeated predictions.
scaling.zh: 预训练并未消亡；尽管屡次被预言，规模扩张仍在继续。

scaling.en: AI model companies may end up like telecoms: huge capex, low profits.
scaling.zh: AI 模型公司可能最终像电信业：巨额资本支出，低利润。

scaling.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns; we are seeing data walls and compute limits today.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律正遭遇收益递减；我们今天已看到数据墙和算力限制。

scaling.en: Reasoning models like o1 show paradigm shift; scaling continues.
scaling.zh: 像 o1 这样的推理模型展示了范式转变；Scaling 仍在继续。

scaling.en: Human baseline in wet lab evals was beaten by early reasoning models.
scaling.zh: 湿实验室评估中的人类基线被早期推理模型击败。

scaling.en: Export controls forced China to innovate, leading to more efficient models and domestic silicon development.
scaling.zh: 出口管制迫使中国创新，催生了更高效的模型和本土芯片发展。

scaling.en: Power is the biggest bottleneck for AI infrastructure, and resistance to data centers will worsen.
scaling.zh: 电力是 AI 基础设施的最大瓶颈，对数据中心的抵制将加剧。

scaling.en: Micron could be more valuable than Meta in 6-12 months due to HBM bottleneck.
scaling.zh: 由于 HBM 瓶颈，美光可能在 6-12 个月内比 Meta 更有价值。

scaling.en: Pre-training has not hit a wall; gains continue richly, and the narrative of plateauing is false.
scaling.zh: 预训练并未触及瓶颈；收益持续丰厚，关于平台期的说法是错误的。

scaling.en: Compute constraints will persist for years, driving efficiency innovations and benefiting alternative chip providers.
scaling.zh: 算力约束将持续数年，推动效率创新，并使替代芯片供应商受益。

scaling.en: Frontier labs may suspend or heavily limit API access due to compute constraints, not as a business decision.
scaling.zh: 前沿实验室可能因算力限制而暂停或严格限制 API 访问，这并非商业决策。

scaling.en: A small team of AI researchers can achieve major breakthroughs in biology.
scaling.zh: 一小群 AI 研究人员就能在生物学上取得重大突破。

scaling.en: The biggest bottleneck is generating novel biological data, not compute.
scaling.zh: 最大的瓶颈是生成新的生物学数据，而不是算力。

scaling.en: Scaling laws drove AI progress; more data and compute improve models even without algorithmic changes.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律推动了 AI 进步；即使算法不变，更多数据和算力也能提升模型。

scaling.en: Superintelligence is coming soon, driven by log-linear scaling of compute and data.
scaling.zh: 超级智能即将到来，由算力和数据的对数线性扩展驱动。

scaling.en: Distillation is a short-term win; true frontier progress requires original research.
scaling.zh: 蒸馏是短期胜利；真正的前沿进步需要原创研究。

scaling.en: The current pricing and capacity crunch is transitory, similar to early mobile data.
scaling.zh: 当前的定价和容量危机是暂时的，类似于早期移动数据市场。

scaling.en: The risk of underinvesting in AI may be overstated; financial gravity limits capex.
scaling.zh: 对 AI 投资不足的风险可能被夸大；财务重力限制了资本支出。

scaling.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems to achieve token efficiency.
scaling.zh: 不要将前沿模型用于非前沿问题，以实现代币效率。

scaling.en: Meta rebuilt its AI scaling ladder and infrastructure over the past year, leading to the Spark model.
scaling.zh: Meta 在过去一年重建了 AI Scaling（规模扩张）阶梯和基础设施，推出了 Spark 模型。

scaling.en: Software complexity has grown due to hyper-focus on scale, trading away simplicity and ease.
scaling.zh: 由于过度关注规模，软件复杂性增加，牺牲了简单性和易用性。

scaling.en: We built more Azure capacity in 15 months than in the first 15 years.
scaling.zh: 我们在 15 个月内建造的 Azure 容量超过了前 15 年。

scaling.en: Compressing progress in frontier AI leads to volatility, but long-term durable progress is key.
scaling.zh: 前沿 AI 的快速进步带来波动，但长期可持续进展是关键。

scaling.en: Compressing progress into short timeframes leads to both good and bad outcomes in months.
scaling.zh: 将进展压缩到短时间内会导致好与坏的结果在几个月内出现。

scaling.en: Test-time compute scaling lets models think longer, improving reasoning accuracy.
scaling.zh: 测试时算力扩展让模型思考更久，提升推理准确性。

scaling.en: Digital AI's ability to share information billions of times faster than humans is a major advantage.
scaling.zh: 数字 AI 以比人类快数十亿倍的速度共享信息，这是一大优势。

scaling.en: Fragmentation in the AI landscape is a major bottleneck for progress.
scaling.zh: AI 领域的碎片化是进展的主要瓶颈。

scaling.en: Scaling for performance will shift from stacking more layers to nesting more frequency update rates.
scaling.zh: 性能的 Scaling 将从堆叠更多层转向嵌套更多频率更新率。

scaling.en: US hyperscalers may be overspending on AI infrastructure despite current demand exceeding supply.
scaling.zh: 尽管当前需求超过供给，美国超大规模云服务商可能在 AI 基础设施上过度支出。

scaling.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools can solve hard problems but still need vast data.
scaling.zh: Transformer 结合推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题，但仍需海量数据。

scaling.en: Hardware progress enables single-GPU research at scale, democratizing AI experimentation.
scaling.zh: 硬件进步使单 GPU 大规模研究成为可能，推动了 AI 实验的民主化。

scaling.en: The big coding leap over Christmas is hard to attribute to a single factor; it's a messy combination.
scaling.zh: 圣诞节期间编码能力的巨大飞跃难以归因于单一因素，而是多种因素的复杂组合。

scaling.en: Model improvements, especially Sonnet 4 and Opus 4.5, were the primary driver of Claude Code's performance gains.
scaling.zh: 模型改进，尤其是 Sonnet 4 和 Opus 4.5，是 Claude Code 性能提升的主要驱动力。

scaling.en: Video model training cost is comparable to medium-scale language models, with huge storage needs.
scaling.zh: 视频模型训练成本与中等规模语言模型相当，且存储需求巨大。

scaling.en: Demis regrets DeepMind being late to language models and chatbots.
scaling.zh: Demis 后悔 DeepMind 在语言模型和聊天机器人上落后了。

scaling.en: Google DeepMind's diversified approach may be a weakness against focused startups like Anthropic.
scaling.zh: Google DeepMind 的多元化策略可能不如 Anthropic 等专注型初创公司。

scaling.en: Very expensive frontier models may not be needed; hybrid systems with sub-frontier models can be efficient.
scaling.zh: 可能不需要非常昂贵的前沿模型；结合次前沿模型的混合系统可以更高效。

scaling.en: AI removes talent bottleneck in science by scaling reasoning and throughput.
scaling.zh: AI 通过扩展推理和吞吐量，消除了科学中的人才瓶颈。

scaling.en: Scientific progress in medicine has slowed due to low-hanging fruit depletion and 'better than the Beatles' problem.
scaling.zh: 医学科学进展因低垂果实耗尽和‘比披头士更好’问题而放缓。

scaling.en: Scaling laws apply to protein language models, with more data and compute leading to emergent capabilities.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律适用于蛋白质语言模型，更多数据和算力会带来涌现能力。

scaling.en: Adding metagenomic data removes diminishing returns, enabling better scaling than with UniRef alone.
scaling.zh: 加入宏基因组数据消除了收益递减，比仅用 UniRef 实现了更好的 Scaling。

scaling.en: No inductive biases like MSAs are needed; scaling data and compute alone yields state-of-the-art structure prediction.
scaling.zh: 不需要多序列比对等归纳偏置；仅靠 Scaling 数据和算力就能达到最先进的结构预测。

scaling.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律仍然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失的能力。

scaling.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but compute constraints will widen the US-China gap.
scaling.zh: 预训练的缩放定律仍然成立，但算力限制将扩大中美差距。

scaling.en: Chinese labs are 6-9 months behind on benchmarks, but gap may grow on knowledge work.
scaling.zh: 中国实验室在基准测试上落后 6-9 个月，但在知识工作上的差距可能扩大。

scaling.en: Huawei chips work for inference but not training; labs buy them but don't use.
scaling.zh: 华为芯片可用于推理但非训练；实验室购买但未使用。

scaling.en: Scaling laws require a working system first; studying scaling on bad data yields no insight.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律需要先有工作系统；在坏数据上研究缩放无法获得洞察。

scaling.en: Scaling LLMs will not lead to human-level AI; a paradigm shift is needed.
scaling.zh: 扩展 LLM 不会带来人类级 AI；需要范式转变。

scaling.en: Infrastructure scaling is the hardest part of productionizing agents.
scaling.zh: 基础设施扩展是代理产品化中最困难的部分。

scaling.en: Platform must scale to handle agents that constantly run and recreate themselves.
scaling.zh: 平台必须扩展以处理持续运行和自重建的代理。

scaling.en: Sample efficiency improvements mean AI intelligence can grow even without more compute, accelerating progress.
scaling.zh: 样本效率的提升意味着即使没有更多算力，AI 智能也能增长，从而加速进步。

scaling.en: The core code for an LLM is only 200-300 lines; complexity comes from data and scaling.
scaling.zh: LLM 的核心代码仅 200-300 行；复杂性来自数据和规模扩展。

scaling.en: Agent scaffolding and inference compute scaling are crucial for eliciting model capabilities on hard tasks.
scaling.zh: 智能体框架和推理算力扩展对于在困难任务上激发模型能力至关重要。

scaling.en: AI progress may be overestimated due to data contamination and distributional leakage in benchmarks.
scaling.zh: 由于基准中的数据污染和分布泄露，AI 进展可能被高估。

scaling.en: The bottleneck for commercializing humanoid robots is scaling production and achieving human-level performance reliably.
scaling.zh: 人形机器人商业化的瓶颈在于扩大生产并可靠地达到人类水平的性能。

scaling.en: The humanoid robot space is still in its first chapter; we are years ahead of global competitors.
scaling.zh: 人形机器人领域仍处于第一章；我们领先全球竞争对手数年。

scaling.en: Demand for intelligence is unlimited; scaling compute is key as long as margins are positive.
scaling.zh: 对智能的需求是无限的；只要利润率是正的，扩大算力就是关键。

scaling.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost.
scaling.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练至 Chinchilla 最优的约 100 倍。

scaling.en: Distillation allows packing frontier model capabilities into smaller, efficient models for edge deployment.
scaling.zh: 蒸馏技术可将前沿模型能力压缩到更小、更高效的模型中，用于边缘部署。

scaling.en: Context length is the slowest scaling factor in LLMs; memory is likely the biggest limiting constraint.
scaling.zh: 上下文长度是 LLM 中最慢的扩展因素；记忆可能是最大的限制约束。

scaling.en: The scaling of models beyond 10 trillion parameters is temporary; rationing will not last.
scaling.zh: 模型规模超过 10 万亿参数是暂时的；配给不会持续。

scaling.en: Robotics is a data problem; there is no internet of robot data, so we must use all available data sources.
scaling.zh: 机器人技术是一个数据问题；没有机器人数据的互联网，所以我们必须利用所有可用的数据来源。

scaling.en: Pretraining on diverse data (videos, simulation) and post-training on real-world data is the key recipe.
scaling.zh: 在多样化数据（视频、模拟）上进行预训练，并在真实世界数据上进行后训练是关键方法。

scaling.en: A data flywheel across verticals enables scaling from structured to unstructured environments.
scaling.zh: 跨垂直领域的数据飞轮使得从结构化到非结构化环境的扩展成为可能。

scaling.en: AI is capital-intensive R&D requiring massive compute for training strong models.
scaling.zh: AI 是资本密集型研发，需要大量算力来训练强大模型。

scaling.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver requires massive data, compute, and world models for simulation.
scaling.zh: 扩展通用 AI 驾驶系统需要海量数据、算力和用于仿真的世界模型。

scaling.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation for deep learning.
scaling.zh: 对于深度学习，基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更为关键。

scaling.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible without prior training data.
scaling.zh: 无需预先训练数据，即可在 500 多个城市实现零样本泛化。

scaling.en: AI for science is progressing, with models generating novel ideas in math and physics.
scaling.zh: AI 在科学领域取得进展，模型在数学和物理中产生新想法。

scaling.en: Anthropic's growth is driven by exponential model improvements, not just growth team optimizations.
scaling.zh: Anthropic 的增长主要源于模型的指数级进步，而非单纯的增长团队优化。

scaling.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive progress in physical sciences, similar to AI.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律和大规模实验将推动物理科学的进步，类似于 AI 领域。

scaling.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus, and diffusion models scale better at inference than autoregressive models.
scaling.zh: 推理时缩放现在是关键焦点，扩散模型在推理时比自回归模型扩展得更好。

scaling.en: Current AI is the worst we'll ever see; it will become much more energy efficient.
scaling.zh: 当前的 AI 是我们见过的最差的；它将变得节能得多。

scaling.en: Real-world data is crucial for manipulation tasks; simulation struggles with world complexity.
scaling.zh: 真实世界数据对操作任务至关重要；模拟难以应对世界复杂性。

scaling.en: Scaling existing recipes may suffice; research can improve scaling slope.
scaling.zh: 扩展现有方案可能足够；研究可改善扩展斜率。

scaling.en: Simulation is less useful for manipulation than for locomotion.
scaling.zh: 模拟对操作任务不如对运动任务有用。

scaling.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
scaling.zh: 大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

scaling.en: Scaling laws continue to hold for both pre-training and reasoning models.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律在预训练和推理模型上仍然成立。

scaling.en: Digital intelligence may surpass analog brains because it can scale and share knowledge instantly.
scaling.zh: 数字智能可能超越模拟大脑，因为它能规模化并即时共享知识。

scaling.en: Inference scaling techniques like self-consistency and self-refinement boost model performance at test time.
scaling.zh: 自洽性和自我改进等推理缩放技术可在测试时提升模型性能。

scaling.en: Pre-training R&D is less exciting; most gains now come from post-training and inference scaling.
scaling.zh: 预训练的研发不再令人兴奋；大部分收益现在来自后训练和推理缩放。

scaling.en: Scaling laws show intelligence emerges from data, compute, and model size.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律表明智能从数据、算力和模型规模中涌现。

scaling.en: Speed of 53 Codex enables real-time interaction and new capabilities like mid-turn steering.
scaling.zh: 53 Codex 的速度实现了实时交互和诸如中途转向等新能力。

scaling.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
scaling.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

scaling.en: Codex app slows down output slightly for smoother user experience.
scaling.zh: Codex 应用会稍微放慢输出速度，以获得更流畅的用户体验。

scaling.en: A four-year-old's visual data equals all public text on the internet.
scaling.zh: 四岁儿童的视觉数据相当于互联网上所有公开文本。

scaling.en: Unprecedented compute scaling drives linear capability gains, justifying massive CAPEX.
scaling.zh: 前所未有的算力规模扩张带来线性能力提升，证明了巨额资本支出的合理性。

scaling.en: The data problem is the main bottleneck in robotics; real-world data is scarce and expensive to collect.
scaling.zh: 数据问题是机器人技术的主要瓶颈；现实世界的数据稀缺且采集成本高昂。

scaling.en: Synthetic data, generated through simulation and world models, is the future for scaling robot learning.
scaling.zh: 通过模拟和世界模型生成的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

scaling.en: Robots can achieve super-dog performance, as shown by a robot dog balancing on a yoga ball, surpassing real dogs.
scaling.zh: 机器人可以实现超级狗的性能，如机器狗在瑜伽球上保持平衡，超越了真实的狗。

scaling.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
scaling.zh: 将非形式模型 Scaling 到数学 AI 不可行；形式验证对于可靠的证明至关重要。

scaling.en: Compute power is the new oil; chip supply is the current bottleneck for AI progress.
scaling.zh: 算力是新的石油；芯片供应是当前 AI 进展的瓶颈。

scaling.en: Space data centers will not provide meaningful compute for OpenAI in the next 10 years.
scaling.zh: 太空数据中心在未来 10 年内不会为 OpenAI 提供有意义的算力。

scaling.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation.
scaling.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍。

scaling.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization beyond training data remains limited.
scaling.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习可预测地提升模型，但超出训练数据的泛化仍然有限。

scaling.en: Scaling RL alone may not lead to AGI; continual learning is a necessary element.
scaling.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习可能无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；持续学习是必要元素。

scaling.en: Small language models can be made powerful with high-quality, diverse synthetic data.
scaling.zh: 通过高质量、多样化的合成数据，小型语言模型可以变得强大。

scaling.en: Post-training data must be diverse to avoid mode collapse and homogeneity.
scaling.zh: 后训练数据必须多样化，以避免模式崩溃和同质化。

scaling.en: Synthetic data generation requires careful filtering for diversity and quality.
scaling.zh: 合成数据生成需要仔细过滤以确保多样性和质量。

scaling.en: OpenAI's per-user economics worsen as they scale; they lose more money per user.
scaling.zh: OpenAI 的单位经济随规模扩大而恶化；每个用户亏损更多。

scaling.en: Pre-training is hitting a saturation wall; further gains come from domain-specific fine-tuning.
scaling.zh: 预训练正触及饱和墙；进一步收益来自领域特定微调。

scaling.en: Video pre-training offers higher scaling ceiling than text for world understanding.
scaling.zh: 视频预训练在理解世界方面比文本有更高的扩展上限。

scaling.en: Scaling video models has a much higher ceiling than text models due to information density.
scaling.zh: 由于信息密度，视频模型的扩展上限远高于文本模型。

scaling.en: Diverse data is key to generalization in robotics foundation models.
scaling.zh: 多样化数据是机器人基础模型泛化能力的关键。

scaling.en: Deployment enables a data flywheel: more deployment yields more data, which improves models.
scaling.zh: 部署带来数据飞轮：更多部署产生更多数据，从而改进模型。

scaling.en: Sim-to-real transfer works for locomotion but not for manipulation due to world complexity.
scaling.zh: 由于世界的复杂性，仿真到现实的迁移适用于运动控制，但不适用于操作任务。

scaling.en: Scaling models is key to discovering emergent capabilities, which can later be distilled into smaller models.
scaling.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）模型是发现涌现能力的关键，这些能力随后可以蒸馏到更小的模型中。

scaling.en: Synthetic data can help if it preserves natural data distribution; pure synthetic data harms performance.
scaling.zh: 合成数据如果保持自然数据分布则有益；纯合成数据会损害性能。

scaling.en: The current AI monoculture in Silicon Valley focusing on scaling LLMs is misguided.
scaling.zh: 硅谷当前专注于 Scaling LLM 的 AI 单一文化是误导性的。

scaling.en: AlphaFold's success came from lack of compute, not abundance.
scaling.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于算力不足，而非充裕。

scaling.en: The history of deep learning is the history of scaling up compute.
scaling.zh: 深度学习的历史就是 Scaling（规模扩张）算力的历史。

scaling.en: Academia should focus on wacky ideas and new algorithms, not just scaling models.
scaling.zh: 学术界应专注于疯狂的想法和新算法，而不仅仅是 Scaling（规模扩张）模型。

scaling.en: GPU scaling is hitting limits; future hardware may require radically different neural architectures.
scaling.zh: GPU Scaling（规模扩张）正触及极限；未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经网络架构。

scaling.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we are returning to an era of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
scaling.zh: 预训练的缩放定律是有限的；我们正回归研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

scaling.en: Scaling laws and brute force can mask fundamental architectural flaws, such as poor representation of structure.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律和蛮力可以掩盖根本性的架构缺陷，例如对结构的糟糕表示。

scaling.en: Scaling laws apply to video models, with rapid cost reduction and intelligence gains.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律适用于视频模型，成本快速降低且智能显著提升。

scaling.en: Synthetic data from LLMs is collapsed and lacks entropy; training on it leads to model collapse, unlike human diversity.
scaling.zh: LLM 生成的合成数据坍缩且缺乏熵；在其上训练导致模型坍缩，不像人类具有多样性。

scaling.en: Model collapse from synthetic data is a fundamental problem; entropy is needed.
scaling.zh: 合成数据导致的模型崩溃是一个根本性问题；需要熵。

scaling.en: Generalization in deep learning is poorly understood and often requires human engineering.
scaling.zh: 深度学习中的泛化理解不足，常需人工设计。

scaling.en: Scaling large language models is not the bitter lesson; true scaling comes from learning from experience.
scaling.zh: 扩展大型语言模型并非苦涩教训；真正的扩展来自从经验中学习。

scaling.en: The cost of AI inference will drop dramatically, enabling new use cases and business models.
scaling.zh: AI 推理成本将大幅下降，催生新的用例和商业模式。

scaling.en: Pre-training is a key muscle to rebuild; scaling laws are not dead and there is much room left.
scaling.zh: 预训练是需要重建的关键能力；缩放定律并未失效，仍有很大空间。

scaling.en: Product innovation lags behind AI capabilities; freezing models would still yield a decade of product progress.
scaling.zh: 产品创新落后于 AI 能力；冻结模型仍将带来十年的产品进步。

scaling.en: Scaling laws show intelligence increases reliably with more compute, a key insight for AI progress.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律表明，随着算力增加，智能会可靠提升，这是 AI 进展的关键洞见。

scaling.en: Humanity is on track for the largest infrastructure buildout ever, with compute spending tripling yearly.
scaling.zh: 人类正经历史上最大的基础设施建设，算力支出每年翻三倍。

scaling.en: Using multiple GPU types (NVIDIA, TPU, Trainium) is a strategic advantage despite engineering overhead.
scaling.zh: 使用多种 GPU 类型（NVIDIA、TPU、Trainium）尽管增加工程开销，却是战略优势。

scaling.en: Scaling laws lead to emergent capabilities that create new failure modes.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律导致涌现能力，从而产生新的失败模式。

scaling.en: The exponential means models will get millions of times better, not just twice.
scaling.zh: 指数增长意味着模型将变得好数百万倍，而不仅仅是两倍。

scaling.en: Scaling reasoning models will accelerate AI progress in coming years.
scaling.zh: 扩展推理模型将在未来几年加速 AI 进步。

scaling.en: Measuring AI capabilities is becoming a bottleneck; benchmarks lag behind.
scaling.zh: 衡量 AI 能力正成为瓶颈；基准测试落后于实际能力。

scaling.en: Frontier model development is dominated by hyperscalers and large labs due to massive capex requirements, making it unsuitable for startups.
scaling.zh: 前沿模型开发由超大规模企业和大型实验室主导，因为需要巨额资本支出，不适合初创公司。

scaling.en: The Protein Data Bank's high-quality curated data was essential for training AlphaFold.
scaling.zh: 蛋白质数据库的高质量精选数据对训练 AlphaFold 至关重要。

scaling.en: Future AI in biology needs new curated datasets like the PDB for other modalities.
scaling.zh: 生物学未来的 AI 需要像 PDB 那样为其他模态策划的新数据集。

scaling.en: Scaling compute in pre-training and RL predictably improves AI performance.
scaling.zh: 在预训练和强化学习中扩展算力可预测地提升 AI 性能。

scaling.en: Scaling laws have held over five orders of magnitude, suggesting continued progress.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律已在五个数量级上成立，表明进步将持续。

scaling.en: Scaling laws failing likely means we screwed up training, not that scaling is over.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律失效很可能意味着训练出错，而非缩放本身终结。

scaling.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robot models; diverse data is key.
scaling.zh: 规模是通用机器人模型的必要条件，但非充分条件；数据的多样性才是关键。

scaling.en: Scaling laws continue to hold; progress is accelerating with more frequent model releases.
scaling.zh: 缩放定律持续成立；随着模型发布频率加快，进步正在加速。

scaling.en: Biggest bottleneck for AI progress is compute (chips and data centers), plus algorithms and data.
scaling.zh: AI 进步的最大瓶颈是算力（芯片和数据中心），其次是算法和数据。

scaling.en: AI progress is not slowing; it's accelerating due to post-training improvements and faster releases.
scaling.zh: AI 进步并未放缓；由于后训练改进和更快的发布，实际上正在加速。

scaling.en: The bitter lesson is about scaling with compute and search, not about generalization.
scaling.zh: 苦涩的教训是关于用算力和搜索进行扩展，而非关于泛化。

scaling.en: Pre-training scaling is far from saturated; significant gains are still possible.
scaling.zh: 预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）远未饱和，仍有显著提升空间。

scaling.en: Sim-to-real gap persists but is reduced for many tasks.
scaling.zh: 模拟到现实的差距仍然存在，但许多任务已缩小。

scaling.en: Scaling RL compute will unlock new capabilities, similar to how pre-training scaling improved generalization.
scaling.zh: 扩大强化学习算力将解锁新能力，类似于预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）提升了泛化能力。

scaling.en: DeepSeek's success is due to efficient engineering and hardware-aware design, not fundamental algorithmic breakthroughs.
scaling.zh: DeepSeek 的成功源于高效工程和硬件感知设计，而非根本性的算法突破。

scaling.en: DeepSeek's success is due to efficient engineering and hardware-aware design, not algorithmic novelty.
scaling.zh: DeepSeek 的成功归功于高效的工程和硬件感知设计，而非算法创新。

scaling.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost reasons.
scaling.zh: 定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其是在速度和成本方面。

scaling.en: We didn't expect to do our own model development, but now every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
scaling.zh: 我们最初没预料到会自己开发模型，但现在 Cursor 的每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

scaling.en: Data diversity is the main bottleneck in robotics; sharing datasets across the community can solve generalization issues.
scaling.zh: 数据多样性是机器人技术的主要瓶颈；跨社区共享数据集可以解决泛化问题。

scaling.en: Biology is not data-constrained; historical data exists but wasn't created for ML.
scaling.zh: 生物学并不受数据限制；历史数据存在，但并非为机器学习而创建。

scaling.en: Synthetic data from physics simulations is a massive opportunity for chemistry.
scaling.zh: 来自物理模拟的合成数据为化学领域提供了巨大机遇。

scaling.en: Test-time compute scaling will drive major progress, but won't alone achieve AGI.
scaling.zh: 测试时算力扩展将推动重大进展，但仅靠它无法实现 AGI。

scaling.en: The speed of AI research adoption has dramatically accelerated in recent years.
scaling.zh: AI 研究的采纳速度近年来显著加快。

scaling.en: Top-down compute allocation can miss breakthrough ideas; bottom-up is essential.
scaling.zh: 自上而下的算力分配可能错过突破性想法；自下而上至关重要。

scaling.en: Synthetic data enables infinite task generation for post-training, overcoming the data wall in pre-training.
scaling.zh: 合成数据为后训练生成无限任务，克服了预训练中的数据墙。

scaling.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created.
scaling.zh: 评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建。

scaling.en: Models are not running out of data; post-training scaling via RL offers infinite tasks.
scaling.zh: 模型并未耗尽数据；通过强化学习的后训练扩展提供了无限任务。

scaling.en: Scaling and planning are key principles from AlphaGo to modern AI agents.
scaling.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）和规划是从 AlphaGo 到现代 AI 智能体的关键原则。

scaling.en: Synthetic data is essential to overcome the data wall, but requires careful methods.
