economy-jobs.en: Partnerships with pharma drive adoption; models must deliver real value to partners.
economy-jobs.zh: 与制药公司的合作推动采用；模型必须为合作伙伴带来实际价值。

economy-jobs.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas become the differentiator, making design tools more valuable.
economy-jobs.zh: 随着工程变得更容易，设计和创意成为差异化因素，使设计工具更有价值。

economy-jobs.en: The ability to rapidly prototype enables features that would never have seen the light of day in the previous era.
economy-jobs.zh: 快速原型制作的能力使得在前一时代永远不会见天日的功能得以实现。

economy-jobs.en: In the AI era, being uncomfortably early to ideas is more valuable than polishing, so shipping rough products is acceptable.
economy-jobs.zh: 在 AI 时代，对想法保持不适的早期状态比打磨更有价值，因此发布粗糙的产品是可以接受的。

economy-jobs.en: Automation creates more human work, not less, as frozen competencies become commoditized and experts are needed to tailor them.
economy-jobs.zh: 自动化创造更多人类工作而非更少，因为冻结的能力变得商品化，需要专家来定制。

economy-jobs.en: The fear that AI will take away jobs is overblown; it actually creates more opportunities for skilled people.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 将夺走工作的恐惧被夸大了；实际上它为有技能的人创造了更多机会。

economy-jobs.en: Post-training can be applied to non-tech creative industries, transforming operations.
economy-jobs.zh: 后训练可以应用于非科技创意产业，转变运营方式。

economy-jobs.en: Product management should not be a default role on every team; hire PMs only where there is a specific need.
economy-jobs.zh: 产品管理不应成为每个团队的默认角色；只在有特定需求的地方招聘产品经理。

economy-jobs.en: Empowering engineers and designers to do PM work builds their decision-making muscles and leads to better products.
economy-jobs.zh: 让工程师和设计师承担产品管理工作，能锻炼他们的决策能力，从而打造更好的产品。

economy-jobs.en: Senior PMs should spend most of their time on individual contributor work, not just managing people.
economy-jobs.zh: 资深产品经理应将大部分时间花在个人贡献者工作上，而不仅仅是管理人。

economy-jobs.en: The best way to get feedback is to ask people to pay you.
economy-jobs.zh: 获得反馈的最佳方式是让人们付钱给你。

economy-jobs.en: Essential services like HVAC and roofing have complex operational needs that require deep understanding.
economy-jobs.zh: 暖通空调和屋顶等基本服务的运营需求复杂，需要深入理解。

economy-jobs.en: Building for real-world impact is fulfilling and important, beyond serving tech startups.
economy-jobs.zh: 为现实世界的影响而构建是有成就感且重要的，而不仅仅是为科技初创公司服务。

economy-jobs.en: Private equity playbook has shifted from finding gems to creating tangible value with AI.
economy-jobs.zh: 私募股权的策略已从寻找宝石转向利用 AI 创造实际价值。

economy-jobs.en: Even with advanced AI, cognitive L1 cache knowledge remains faster and more valuable for problem-solving.
economy-jobs.zh: 即便有了先进的 AI，认知一级缓存中的知识在解决问题时仍然更快、更有价值。

economy-jobs.en: Writing and interpersonal communication are fundamental skills that models still lack, so doing them yourself matters.
economy-jobs.zh: 写作和人际沟通是模型仍欠缺的基本技能，因此亲自去做很重要。

economy-jobs.en: Starting a company grounded in a concrete, real customer problem is crucial for success.
economy-jobs.zh: 创办一家基于具体、真实客户问题的公司对成功至关重要。

economy-jobs.en: Startups should target problems where frontier models currently fail almost completely, not where they partly work.
economy-jobs.zh: 创业公司应瞄准前沿模型目前几乎完全失败的问题，而不是部分能解决的问题。

economy-jobs.en: The scarce skill won't be coding but taste: choosing which problems to direct hundreds of agents to solve.
economy-jobs.zh: 稀缺技能不再是编码，而是品味：选择让数百个智能体去解决哪些问题。

economy-jobs.en: Data was a dismissed business that skeptics now call critical; the same investors who passed now celebrate it.
economy-jobs.zh: 数据曾被当作不值得做的生意，如今怀疑者却称其至关重要；当初错过的投资人如今反过来吹捧它。

economy-jobs.en: The most likely outcome is an age of amazing abundance.
economy-jobs.zh: 最可能的结果是一个令人惊叹的富足时代。

economy-jobs.en: AI will not cause a job apocalypse; instead, it will shift skill requirements and create more valuable roles.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 不会导致就业末日；相反，它将转变技能需求并创造更有价值的角色。

economy-jobs.en: AI will make software engineers more valuable, not less, as seen in increased job postings.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 将使软件工程师更有价值，而不是更少，正如职位发布增加所示。

economy-jobs.en: When anyone can build with AI, the bottleneck shifts to ideas and taste; grounded generalists who close feedback loops remain essential.
economy-jobs.zh: 当人人都能用 AI 构建时，瓶颈转向创意与品味；能闭环用户反馈的通用型人才依然不可替代。

economy-jobs.en: Productivity should be measured by progress toward goals and quality at-bats, not proxies like commits, story points, or tokens.
economy-jobs.zh: 衡量生产力应看目标进展和高质量的“打席”，而非提交数、故事点或 token 等代理指标。

economy-jobs.en: Instead of replacing people, AI enables everyone to become T-shaped—both broad generalist and deep specialist—so what you can accomplish becomes nearly limitless.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 不是替代人，而是让每个人都变成 T 型人才——既通又专——因此能做成的事几乎不受限制。

economy-jobs.en: Productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
economy-jobs.zh: 生产力应以结果衡量，而非令牌数量。

economy-jobs.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, leading to even more opportunity.
economy-jobs.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创作将基本解决，带来更多机会。

economy-jobs.en: Solving software creation creates a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
economy-jobs.zh: 解决软件创造问题会带来千倍机会，而非更少。

economy-jobs.en: The pace of change creates opportunity; founders should not overly worry about frontier labs.
economy-jobs.zh: 变化的速度创造机会；创始人不应过度担忧前沿实验室。

economy-jobs.en: Coding is being solved for many tasks; the real value moves to product sense and business skills.
economy-jobs.zh: 编程对许多任务正被解决；真正的价值转向产品直觉和商业技能。

economy-jobs.en: Automation eliminates tasks, not jobs, leading to employment growth.
economy-jobs.zh: 自动化消灭的是任务而非工作，反而带来就业增长。

economy-jobs.en: A multimodal fleet of robots, drones, and dashers will coexist; autonomy creates more demand, not fewer humans.
economy-jobs.zh: 机器人、无人机和骑手将组成多模式车队并共存；自动驾驶创造更多需求，而不是减少人力。

economy-jobs.en: The future of food involves automated production, robotic delivery, and efficiency approaching grocery store costs, transforming the kitchen like Uber did to cars.
economy-jobs.zh: 食品的未来涉及自动化生产、机器人配送以及接近杂货店成本的效率，像 Uber 改变汽车一样改变厨房。

economy-jobs.en: Industrial AI is a stack of software, sensors, robotics, and machinery that automates entire industries, one at a time.
economy-jobs.zh: 工业 AI 是软件、传感器、机器人和机械的堆栈，一次自动化整个行业。

economy-jobs.en: Alphabet raised equity and debt to maintain a resilient balance sheet, not just for growth funding.
economy-jobs.zh: Alphabet 通过股权和债务融资以维持弹性资产负债表，而不仅仅是为了增长资金。

economy-jobs.en: Physicians must integrate AI into practice; it's unethical not to use it, as AI can diagnose better than average doctors.
economy-jobs.zh: 医生必须将 AI 融入实践；不使用 AI 是不道德的，因为 AI 的诊断能力优于普通医生。

economy-jobs.en: AI will make healthcare super affordable, not just for the rich, because drug development costs will drop by orders of magnitude.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 将使医疗保健变得超级实惠，而不仅仅针对富人，因为药物开发成本将下降几个数量级。

economy-jobs.en: Junior designers may lose mentorship opportunities as AI replaces their tasks.
economy-jobs.zh: 初级设计师可能失去指导机会，因为 AI 取代了他们的任务。

economy-jobs.en: Academic labs are struggling to keep pace; industry has major advantages in resources and data generation.
economy-jobs.zh: 学术实验室难以跟上步伐；工业界在资源和数据生成方面具有主要优势。

economy-jobs.en: Enterprise AI adoption requires behavioral change and willingness to experiment.
economy-jobs.zh: 企业 AI 采用需要行为改变和实验意愿。

economy-jobs.en: Being two to three years early is the same as being wrong.
economy-jobs.zh: 早两三年和做错是一样的。

economy-jobs.en: Customer obsession is an input metric; output is creating obsessed customers.
economy-jobs.zh: 客户痴迷是输入指标；输出是创造痴迷的客户。

economy-jobs.en: Physical AI will have a bigger economic impact than digital AI, as it addresses the global economy's physical sectors.
economy-jobs.zh: 物理 AI 将比数字 AI 产生更大的经济影响，因为它涉及全球经济的实体部门。

economy-jobs.en: Truck driving is a terrible job, and the shortage of drivers is a market signal, not a problem to be solved by keeping humans.
economy-jobs.zh: 卡车司机是一份糟糕的工作，司机短缺是市场信号，而不是通过保留人类来解决的问题。

economy-jobs.en: Fear of AI job loss is misplaced; in physical AI, there is a labor shortage, and autonomy is welcomed by operators.
economy-jobs.zh: 对 AI 失业的恐惧是错位的；在物理 AI 领域，存在劳动力短缺，自主性受到运营商的欢迎。

economy-jobs.en: Enterprises adopt AI coding tools gradually, moving up an adoption ladder.
economy-jobs.zh: 企业逐步采用 AI 编码工具，沿着采用阶梯向上移动。

economy-jobs.en: AI is a tool that can be used for good or bad, and its impact depends on human choices.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 是一种工具，可以用于善或恶，其影响取决于人类的选择。

economy-jobs.en: AI blurs roles but functional expertise remains critical for quality and accountability.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 模糊了角色边界，但职能专长对质量和问责仍至关重要。

economy-jobs.en: AI fluency is a non-negotiable expectation across all roles and levels.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 素养是所有角色和级别不可妥协的期望。

economy-jobs.en: Humans remain accountable for AI outputs; craft mastery and judgment are scarce.
economy-jobs.zh: 人类仍需对 AI 输出负责；工艺掌握和判断力依然稀缺。

economy-jobs.en: AI diagnostics now surpass human doctors; free access via platforms like Meta democratizes healthcare.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 诊断现已超越人类医生；通过 Meta 等平台免费访问使医疗民主化。

economy-jobs.en: The number of accountants has risen throughout the 20th century despite automation, suggesting AI may not eliminate jobs as feared.
economy-jobs.zh: 尽管自动化，20 世纪会计师数量仍在增加，这表明 AI 可能不会像人们担心的那样消除就业。

economy-jobs.en: Jeff Hinton's warning about radiologists was flawed because he misunderstood the job; AI won't replace professionals but change their tasks.
economy-jobs.zh: 杰夫·辛顿关于放射科医生的警告有缺陷，因为他误解了这份工作；AI 不会取代专业人士，而是改变他们的任务。

economy-jobs.en: The 'jagged edge' of AI capabilities means it can do some complex tasks but fails at simple ones, making predictions of job impact unreliable.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 能力的“锯齿状边缘”意味着它能完成一些复杂任务，但在简单任务上失败，这使得对就业影响的预测不可靠。

economy-jobs.en: Building in AI era requires embracing exploration and uncertainty; it's no longer the safe path.
economy-jobs.zh: 在 AI 时代创业需要拥抱探索和不确定性；这不再是安全路径。

economy-jobs.en: Evals are not for zero-to-one innovation; founders should iterate fast without heavy evals initially.
economy-jobs.zh: 评估不适用于从零到一的创新；创始人应快速迭代而非初期大量评估。

economy-jobs.en: Data centers are net positive for local communities, bringing jobs, tax revenue, and grid upgrades.
economy-jobs.zh: 数据中心对当地社区净正面，带来就业、税收和电网升级。

economy-jobs.en: AI will not cause mass unemployment; jobs will transform instead of vanish.
economy-jobs.zh: 人工智能不会导致大规模失业；工作将转型而非消失。

economy-jobs.en: Big tech companies will lose billions due to lack of business models, not dominate.
economy-jobs.zh: 大型科技公司因缺乏商业模式将损失数十亿，而非主导市场。

economy-jobs.en: The little guy will profit most from AI as compute becomes cheaper, like smartphones.
economy-jobs.zh: 随着算力变得更便宜，小人物将从 AI 中获益最多，就像智能手机一样。

economy-jobs.en: Jobs will be automated entirely; work becomes a political choice.
economy-jobs.zh: 工作将被完全自动化；工作成为政治选择。

economy-jobs.en: Mass unemployment won't happen until after superintelligence is achieved.
economy-jobs.zh: 大规模失业要到超级智能实现后才会发生。

economy-jobs.en: AI can revolutionize healthcare, potentially eradicating cancer and reducing car accidents.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 可以革新医疗，有望根除癌症并减少车祸。

economy-jobs.en: Personalized AI tutors could transform education, a 2000-year-old problem.
economy-jobs.zh: 个性化 AI 导师可以改变教育，这是一个存在了两千年的问题。

economy-jobs.en: Cosine can compete with billions by licensing technology, not selling tokens.
economy-jobs.zh: Cosine 通过授权技术而非出售 token 来与数十亿美元的公司竞争。

economy-jobs.en: AI bifurcates tech workforce: half feel amplified, half destabilized or diminished.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 导致科技劳动力分化：一半人感到能力增强，另一半感到不稳定或被削弱。

economy-jobs.en: Burnout surged from 44.7% to 54.7%, optimism dropped from 54.8% to 48.7% in one year.
economy-jobs.zh: 一年内倦怠率从 44.7%升至 54.7%，乐观度从 54.8%降至 48.7%。

economy-jobs.en: Top fear is expectation to do more for same pay, not losing job to AI.
economy-jobs.zh: 首要恐惧是期望以相同薪酬做更多工作，而非被 AI 取代。

economy-jobs.en: Gradual disempowerment of biological humans is 100% inevitable and not necessarily bad.
economy-jobs.zh: 生物人类的逐渐失能是 100%不可避免的，且未必是坏事。

economy-jobs.en: The massive capex in AI data centers is overdone and will lead to a stock market crash.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 数据中心的大规模资本支出过度，将导致股市崩盘。

economy-jobs.en: Taste matters more as AI makes building easier; focus on what to build.
economy-jobs.zh: 品味在 AI 让构建更容易的时代更重要；专注于应该构建什么。

economy-jobs.en: Smaller teams with generalists move faster; product staff role blends PM, design, data science.
economy-jobs.zh: 更小的全栈团队行动更快；产品人员角色融合了 PM、设计和数据科学。

economy-jobs.en: AI content is a tailwind for Instagram; people will seek authenticity and creators.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 内容对 Instagram 是顺风；人们会寻求真实性和创作者。

economy-jobs.en: Organizations must adopt a leadership, lab, and crowd model to harness AI, with leaders setting direction, crowds discovering use cases, and labs building solutions.
economy-jobs.zh: 组织必须采用领导、实验室和群众模式来利用 AI，领导设定方向，群众发现用例，实验室构建解决方案。

economy-jobs.en: AI's weirdness should be embraced, not normalized; IT departments often kill AI by treating it as a standard software, limiting its transformative potential.
economy-jobs.zh: 应拥抱 AI 的怪异之处，而非将其常态化；IT 部门常因将 AI 视为标准软件而扼杀其变革潜力。

economy-jobs.en: The paradox of delegation: by handing tasks to AI, we lose the opportunity to build expertise needed to judge AI output; experts are needed now more than ever.
economy-jobs.zh: 委派悖论：将任务交给 AI，我们失去了培养判断 AI 输出所需专业知识的机会；现在比以往更需要专家。

economy-jobs.en: Fragrance design is a viable first business for olfactory AI, funding further research and data collection.
economy-jobs.zh: 香氛设计是嗅觉 AI 可行的首个业务，为后续研究和数据收集提供资金。

economy-jobs.en: Medical diagnostics like cancer detection via smell are not good businesses due to regulatory and data challenges.
economy-jobs.zh: 通过气味进行癌症检测等医疗诊断并非好生意，因监管和数据挑战。

economy-jobs.en: Autonomous delivery is becoming cheaper than human delivery.
economy-jobs.zh: 自主配送正变得比人工配送更便宜。

economy-jobs.en: The primary problem of AGI is not capability but power concentration.
economy-jobs.zh: AGI 的主要问题不是能力，而是权力集中。

economy-jobs.en: Liquid AI targets device-native foundation models for edge devices, a massive market beyond data centers.
economy-jobs.zh: Liquid AI 瞄准边缘设备的设备原生基础模型，这是一个超越数据中心的大市场。

economy-jobs.en: Hardware makers should invest in an intelligence layer (like Nvidia's NeMo) to differentiate, not just optimize kernels.
economy-jobs.zh: 硬件制造商应投资智能层（如英伟达的 NeMo）以差异化，而不仅仅是优化内核。

economy-jobs.en: Deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software tech, not just military size.
economy-jobs.zh: 威慑现在取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度，而不仅仅是军事规模。

economy-jobs.en: Startups must go international earlier due to rapid product and technology spread.
economy-jobs.zh: 由于产品和技术的快速传播，初创公司必须更早地走向国际化。

economy-jobs.en: Recreating Silicon Valley requires talent, business-friendly laws, and a culture that rewards entrepreneurial risk.
economy-jobs.zh: 复制硅谷需要人才、有利于商业的法律以及奖励创业风险的文化。

economy-jobs.en: The speed of AI-driven job displacement is the real problem, not the displacement itself.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 导致就业替代的速度才是真正的问题，而非替代本身。

economy-jobs.en: Spending $100k/year on tokens lets you live like a normal citizen in 2028.
economy-jobs.zh: 每年花费 10 万美元在 token 上，就能像 2028 年的普通公民一样生活。

economy-jobs.en: Human desire is irreplaceable; AI users become more productive, not displaced.
economy-jobs.zh: 人类欲望不可替代；使用 AI 的人效率更高，而非被取代。

economy-jobs.en: Claude Tag increases productivity significantly, with 65% of PRs written by it in some orgs.
economy-jobs.zh: Claude Tag 显著提升生产力，在某些组织中 65% 的 PR 由其编写。

economy-jobs.en: AI will replace many jobs, but humans will find new purposes in curiosity and relationships.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 将取代许多工作，但人类会在好奇心和人际关系中找到新目标。

economy-jobs.en: Price cuts for intelligence will continue, but frontier models will always command premium.
economy-jobs.zh: 智能的价格将持续下降，但前沿模型始终享有溢价。

economy-jobs.en: Teaching and relational roles in math will remain stable even with advanced AI.
economy-jobs.zh: 即使有先进的 AI，数学中的教学和关系角色仍将保持稳定。

economy-jobs.en: AI solving millennium problems may not directly translate to economic value.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 解决千禧年问题可能不会直接转化为经济价值。

economy-jobs.en: AI will accelerate scientific advances, especially in biology and medicine.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 将加速科学进步，尤其是在生物学和医学领域。

economy-jobs.en: More jobs will exist if individual productivity outpaces corporate automation.
economy-jobs.zh: 如果个人生产力超过企业自动化，就业岗位会更多。

economy-jobs.en: The benefits of AI should be shared globally, including compensation for the use of humanity's cultural heritage.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 的收益应全球共享，包括对使用人类文化遗产的补偿。

economy-jobs.en: Token efficiency is a key lever for improving model economics; outcome-based pricing could be a future direction.
economy-jobs.zh: Token 效率是改善模型经济性的关键杠杆；基于结果的定价可能是未来的方向。

economy-jobs.en: Consumer AI breakout products are rare due to consolidation and data gravity; making something people want remains hard.
economy-jobs.zh: 由于市场整合和数据引力，消费者 AI 突破性产品很少见；创造人们想要的东西仍然困难。

economy-jobs.en: The most token-productive people are not necessarily the most productive; token usage is gameable and not a good metric.
economy-jobs.zh: Token 使用最多的人不一定是最有生产力的人；Token 使用量可以被操纵，不是好的衡量标准。

economy-jobs.en: AI will democratize access to expertise and intelligence, benefiting humanity broadly.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 将使专业知识和智能的获取民主化，广泛惠及人类。

economy-jobs.en: AI will create more jobs than it displaces, contrary to fixed-sum pessimism.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 创造的就业机会将多于它取代的，这与零和悲观主义相反。

economy-jobs.en: Customer service AI expands the market, not just replaces jobs, due to Jevons paradox.
economy-jobs.zh: 由于杰文斯悖论，客户服务 AI 扩大了市场，而不仅仅是取代工作。

economy-jobs.en: Overfitting to a few customers is better than boiling the ocean; it leads to real products.
economy-jobs.zh: 过度适配少数客户比试图包罗万象更好；这能带来真正的产品。

economy-jobs.en: Training per-team or per-user models can reduce inference costs by orders of magnitude compared to RAG.
economy-jobs.zh: 为每个团队或用户训练模型，相比 RAG 可将推理成本降低几个数量级。

economy-jobs.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models for every individual or team.
economy-jobs.zh: 未来不是一个巨大的前沿模型，而是为每个个人或团队定制的众多模型。

economy-jobs.en: Generative AI tools democratize creativity and enable faster iteration for professionals.
economy-jobs.zh: 生成式 AI 工具使创造力民主化，并让专业人士更快迭代。

economy-jobs.en: The creative industry's concern about AI disclosure may be temporary.
economy-jobs.zh: 创意行业对 AI 披露的担忧可能是暂时的。

economy-jobs.en: Enterprise adoption of coding agents is driving demand for AI-specific security solutions.
economy-jobs.zh: 企业对编码智能体的采用正在推动对 AI 特定安全解决方案的需求。

economy-jobs.en: The first major public prompt injection breach will likely drive widespread adoption of AI insurance.
economy-jobs.zh: 第一次重大的公开提示注入漏洞可能会推动 AI 保险的广泛采用。

economy-jobs.en: AlphaFold enables scientists in resource-limited settings to do complex experiments previously impossible.
economy-jobs.zh: AlphaFold 使资源有限地区的科学家能够进行以前不可能完成的复杂实验。

economy-jobs.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; it's lifted the ceiling of what anyone can do.
economy-jobs.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；它提升了任何人所能做到的上限。

economy-jobs.en: Non-engineers like PMs now ship code, blurring role boundaries.
economy-jobs.zh: 非工程师如产品经理现在也能提交代码，角色边界变得模糊。

economy-jobs.en: Growing next-gen engineers may require apprenticeship models, not traditional paths.
economy-jobs.zh: 培养下一代工程师可能需要学徒模式，而非传统路径。

economy-jobs.en: AI companies are not too big to fail; a cascading failure could trigger government bailout implicitly.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 公司并非大到不能倒；级联失败可能隐含触发政府救助。

economy-jobs.en: Education must integrate AI to empower students and teachers, not ban it.
economy-jobs.zh: 教育必须整合 AI 来赋能学生和教师，而不是禁止它。

economy-jobs.en: AI will cause significant job disruption, but the pie expands; adaptation is key.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 将导致重大就业颠覆，但蛋糕在扩大；适应是关键。

economy-jobs.en: AGI will be recognized when models do most economically valuable work.
economy-jobs.zh: 当模型完成大部分具有经济价值的工作时，AGI 将被认可。

economy-jobs.en: Models can pass OpenAI research interviews, changing hiring.
economy-jobs.zh: 模型能通过 OpenAI 研究面试，改变了招聘方式。

economy-jobs.en: The most important metric in AI is token value per user, maximizing valuable output tokens.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 中最重要的指标是每个用户的 Token 价值，最大化有价值的输出 Token。

economy-jobs.en: Companies should be built with far fewer people, leveraging AI agents for efficiency.
economy-jobs.zh: 公司应该用更少的人来构建，利用 AI 智能体提高效率。

economy-jobs.en: The best model doesn't necessarily win in the consumer space; distribution and optimization matter more.
economy-jobs.zh: 最好的模型不一定在消费领域获胜；分发和优化更为重要。

economy-jobs.en: The idea that AI will create a permanent underclass is overblown; human adoption and trust are slow.
economy-jobs.zh: 关于 AI 将创造永久底层阶级的观点被夸大了；人类的采用和信任是缓慢的。

economy-jobs.en: Apple's iPod bet happened when the company was near collapse; innovation came from going off script rather than repeating Mac-versus-PC.
economy-jobs.zh: 苹果推出 iPod 是一场生死赌注，创新来自打破既有剧本，而不是重复 Mac 对 PC 的僵局。

economy-jobs.en: Stay beginner means fighting habituation: fix small frictions users have learned to ignore, so products truly delight them.
economy-jobs.zh: 保持初学者心态就是对抗习惯化：修复用户已经学会忽略的小摩擦，让产品真正带来惊喜。

economy-jobs.en: Great products are painkillers not vitamins; the iPhone solved the real pain of carrying separate phone, computer, and music player.
economy-jobs.zh: 好产品是止痛药而非维生素；iPhone 解决了必须同时携带手机、电脑和音乐播放器的真实痛点。

economy-jobs.en: Rare diseases may be solved faster than common ones due to patient-driven trials.
economy-jobs.zh: 罕见病可能比常见病更快解决，因为患者驱动的试验更高效。

economy-jobs.en: AI will eliminate many white-collar jobs, requiring society to find new roles and policies like UBI.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 将淘汰许多白领工作，社会需要寻找新角色并制定政策，如全民基本收入。

economy-jobs.en: AI could cause high GDP growth alongside high unemployment and inequality, a rare combination.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 可能导致高 GDP 增长伴随高失业和不平等，这是一种罕见的组合。

economy-jobs.en: Tasks will be automated, not entire jobs; efficiency often creates more work.
economy-jobs.zh: 任务会被自动化，而非整个工作；效率往往创造更多工作。

economy-jobs.en: White-collar tasks will be fully automated by AI in 12-18 months, not jobs.
economy-jobs.zh: 白领任务将在 12-18 个月内被 AI 完全自动化，而非工作岗位。

economy-jobs.en: AI is not a technology; it's the future of the firm.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来。

economy-jobs.en: Every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
economy-jobs.zh: 每个企业都必须构建自己的爬山机器，以复合其代币资本。

economy-jobs.en: CEOs must deeply understand token capital, not just delegate AI to IT.
economy-jobs.zh: CEO 必须深入理解代币资本，而不仅仅是把 AI 交给 IT 部门。

economy-jobs.en: AI enables more new businesses and entrepreneurship, offsetting job displacement concerns.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 催生了更多新企业和创业机会，抵消了就业替代的担忧。

economy-jobs.en: Most companies use AI to increase quantity, not to improve quality, which is a missed opportunity.
economy-jobs.zh: 大多数公司用 AI 增加数量，而不是提高质量，这错失了机会。

economy-jobs.en: Human mathematicians' value will shift to asking right questions and research taste.
economy-jobs.zh: 人类数学家的价值将转向提出正确问题和研究品味。

economy-jobs.en: AI is a tool to empower researchers, not replace them, accelerating science.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 是赋能研究者的工具，而非替代他们，加速科学进步。

economy-jobs.en: AI will cause massive unemployment and societal disruption.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 将导致大规模失业和社会动荡。

economy-jobs.en: Radiologist job loss prediction was wrong due to elastic healthcare demand and broader roles.
economy-jobs.zh: 放射科医生失业的预测错误，因为医疗需求弹性大且角色更广泛。

economy-jobs.en: AI doctors are judged more empathetic than human doctors due to broader data.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 医生因数据更广而被认为比人类医生更有同理心。

economy-jobs.en: The market for formal verification extends beyond niche domains to all AI-generated code.
economy-jobs.zh: 形式验证的市场从利基领域扩展到所有 AI 生成的代码。

economy-jobs.en: Enterprise AI adoption requires strong ROI; spending must yield at least 2x return to avoid collapse.
economy-jobs.zh: 企业采用 AI 需要强劲的投资回报率；支出必须产生至少两倍回报，否则整个体系可能崩溃。

economy-jobs.en: Enterprise AI adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
economy-jobs.zh: 企业采用 AI 的瓶颈在于组织变革，而非模型智能。

economy-jobs.en: Clinical trials remain the ultimate bottleneck; AI accelerates hypothesis generation and operations.
economy-jobs.zh: 临床试验仍是最终瓶颈；AI 加速假设生成和运营。

economy-jobs.en: Relaxing FDA efficacy requirements to only safety could accelerate drug development via real-world evidence.
economy-jobs.zh: 放松 FDA 疗效要求至仅需安全性，可通过真实世界证据加速药物开发。

economy-jobs.en: Companies with unique data (e.g., pharma) will not share it with model makers, preferring separate inference providers.
economy-jobs.zh: 拥有独特数据（如制药）的公司不会与模型制造商共享数据，更倾向于独立的推理提供商。

economy-jobs.en: SaaS is not dying; agents increase SaaS users, and companies should buy SaaS stocks.
economy-jobs.zh: SaaS 不会消亡；智能体会增加 SaaS 用户，公司应该买入 SaaS 股票。

economy-jobs.en: Selling compute to Anthropic is a strategic choice to reinvest revenue, not a sign of doubt.
economy-jobs.zh: 向 Anthropic 出售算力是战略性选择以再投资收入，并非怀疑的信号。

economy-jobs.en: Data markets need incentive structures to respect privacy and reward contributors.
economy-jobs.zh: 数据市场需要激励结构来尊重隐私并奖励贡献者。

economy-jobs.en: The risk of AI extinction is overblown; real dangers are labor and capital issues.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 灭绝风险被夸大；真正的危险是劳动力和资本问题。

economy-jobs.en: Markets reduce uncertainty better than any AI system designed top-down.
economy-jobs.zh: 市场比任何自上而下设计的 AI 系统更能减少不确定性。

economy-jobs.en: Memory prices may double due to AI demand, causing supply chain shocks for consumer hardware.
economy-jobs.zh: 内存价格可能因 AI 需求翻倍，给消费硬件带来供应链冲击。

economy-jobs.en: The gap between benchmark performance and real-world usefulness remains large; models are not yet reliable for complex jobs.
economy-jobs.zh: 基准性能与现实世界实用性之间的差距仍然很大；模型尚不能可靠地完成复杂工作。

economy-jobs.en: The demand for inference engineers will grow 10 to 100 times in the coming years, even with AI-assisted coding.
economy-jobs.zh: 即使有 AI 辅助编程，未来几年对推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

economy-jobs.en: Even with AI-assisted coding, human accountability is essential for mission-critical inference systems; 'can't vibe code uptime'.
economy-jobs.zh: 即使有 AI 辅助编程，关键任务推理系统仍需人类负责；“无法用 vibe 编码保证正常运行时间”。

economy-jobs.en: You can outsource your thinking, but you can't outsource your understanding—that remains the human bottleneck.
economy-jobs.zh: 你可以外包思考，但无法外包理解——这仍然是人类的瓶颈。

economy-jobs.en: Everything is automatable eventually; verifiability determines what is easy or hard to automate now.
economy-jobs.zh: 一切最终都可自动化；可验证性决定了当前自动化的难易程度。

economy-jobs.en: Hiring for AI-native engineers should involve large projects and adversarial testing, not puzzles.
economy-jobs.zh: 招聘 AI 原生工程师应通过大型项目和对抗性测试，而非解谜题。

economy-jobs.en: AI tools like Claude Code and Co-work automate repetitive tasks, freeing humans for creative work.
economy-jobs.zh: 像 Claude Code 和 Co-work 这样的 AI 工具自动化重复性任务，解放人类从事创造性工作。

economy-jobs.en: Waymo's value is not just price; the ability to work during rides is a key advantage.
economy-jobs.zh: Waymo 的价值不仅仅是价格；乘车时工作的能力是一个关键优势。

economy-jobs.en: OpenAI's business model is simple: rent compute and resell it with positive margin, benefiting from Jevons paradox.
economy-jobs.zh: OpenAI 的商业模式很简单：租用算力并以正利润率转售，受益于杰文斯悖论。

economy-jobs.en: Despite higher prices, intelligence returns are so large that demand will outstrip supply, not shrink.
economy-jobs.zh: 尽管价格更高，智能的回报如此之大，以至于需求将超过供给，而非萎缩。

economy-jobs.en: The AI coding market is massive, with Anthropic and OpenAI each generating around $2 billion ARR from coding products.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 编码市场巨大，Anthropic 和 OpenAI 各自从编码产品中产生约 20 亿美元的年经常性收入。

economy-jobs.en: Traditional SaaS is being squeezed; custom AI-native solutions can replace expensive software at a fraction of cost.
economy-jobs.zh: 传统 SaaS 正受到挤压；定制 AI 原生解决方案可以以一小部分成本取代昂贵的软件。

economy-jobs.en: AI integration into the economy can restore growth and strengthen liberal democracies.
economy-jobs.zh: 将 AI 融入经济可以恢复增长并加强自由民主制度。

economy-jobs.en: AI is more likely to save the world than destroy it, by restoring economic growth.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 更可能通过恢复经济增长来拯救世界，而非毁灭它。

economy-jobs.en: Xenophobia and conflict stem from economic stagnation, not inherent human nature.
economy-jobs.zh: 仇外心理和冲突源于经济停滞，而非人性固有缺陷。

economy-jobs.en: The future is mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors, not expensive retrofits.
economy-jobs.zh: 未来是内置传感器的量产车，而非昂贵的改装车。

economy-jobs.en: Consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis in the short and medium term.
economy-jobs.zh: 短期内，消费级车辆将远超无人驾驶出租车的规模。

economy-jobs.en: Autonomous driving can reduce accidents to near zero by eliminating human error.
economy-jobs.zh: 自动驾驶通过消除人为错误，可将事故率降至接近零。

economy-jobs.en: AI's real impact is not speed or efficiency—it lets designers reach adjacent fields that were previously out of reach.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 真正的影響不是速度或效率，而是让设计师能进入以前够不到的邻近领域。

economy-jobs.en: AI often creates more follow-up fixes, making people feel more productive while objective quality suffers.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 往往带来更多后续修复，让人感觉更有产出，但客观质量却受损。

economy-jobs.en: AI won't replace jobs; human taste and craft remain critical for final output.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 不会取代工作；人类的品味和工艺对最终输出仍然至关重要。

economy-jobs.en: Despite talk of role merging, we see more merging of responsibilities, not roles.
economy-jobs.zh: 尽管谈论角色融合，我们看到更多的是职责融合而非角色融合。

economy-jobs.en: Current models are already economically transformative, not just research curiosities.
economy-jobs.zh: 当前模型已具有经济变革性，而不仅是研究新奇事物。

economy-jobs.en: The biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
economy-jobs.zh: 最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致的权力集中。

economy-jobs.en: Personalized AI tutors and health coaches are among the most impactful applications for society.
economy-jobs.zh: 个性化 AI 导师和健康教练是对社会最有影响力的应用之一。

economy-jobs.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 加速原型开发，价值从执行转向创意。

economy-jobs.en: Writing code is now cheap; the bottleneck shifts to ideation, prototyping, testing, and quality assurance.
economy-jobs.zh: 编写代码现在成本低廉；瓶颈转移到构思、原型设计、测试和质量保证。

economy-jobs.en: AI amplifies experienced engineers but threatens mid-career professionals who lack deep expertise to leverage agents.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 放大资深工程师的能力，但威胁到缺乏深厚专业知识来利用智能体的中层职业人士。

economy-jobs.en: AI pilled people work harder than ever; productivity gains lead to more ambition, not leisure.
economy-jobs.zh: 沉迷 AI 的人比以往更努力；生产力提升带来更多雄心，而非闲暇。

economy-jobs.en: Default policies disallowing AI on homework are unenforceable and put students in ethical dilemmas.
economy-jobs.zh: 默认禁止在作业中使用 AI 的政策无法执行，并将学生置于道德困境。

economy-jobs.en: AI-generated text may homogenize writing styles, but could also free us to focus on deeper thinking.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 生成的文本可能使写作风格同质化，但也可能让我们专注于更深层的思考。

economy-jobs.en: AI tools will significantly impact junior employees, and society should discuss labor market changes.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 工具将显著影响初级员工，社会应讨论劳动力市场的变化。

economy-jobs.en: Junior engineers can accelerate learning via simulated projects, compressing years of experience into weeks.
economy-jobs.zh: 初级工程师可以通过模拟项目加速学习，将数年经验压缩到几周内。

economy-jobs.en: Curiosity is the most important skill in the AI era to ask good questions.
economy-jobs.zh: 好奇心是 AI 时代最重要的技能，以便提出好问题。

economy-jobs.en: Writing remains valuable because it forces clear thinking, even as AI writes well.
economy-jobs.zh: 写作仍然有价值，因为它迫使清晰思考，即使 AI 写得很好。

economy-jobs.en: Humans remain the source of deep understanding and creativity; AI amplifies human capabilities.
economy-jobs.zh: 人类仍是深度理解和创造力的源泉；AI 放大了人类的能力。

economy-jobs.en: AI coding assistants can be addictive, reducing deep thinking and grounding.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 编程助手可能让人上瘾，减少深度思考和根基性。

economy-jobs.en: The paper format may persist despite better agent-accessible alternatives for scientific communication.
economy-jobs.zh: 尽管有更好的智能体可访问的替代方案，论文格式可能仍会持续存在。

economy-jobs.en: Musk's claims about Tesla autonomy are consistently wrong for 8 years.
economy-jobs.zh: 马斯克关于特斯拉自动驾驶的说法连续 8 年错误。

economy-jobs.en: AI tool access is widening the gap between startups and legacy enterprises, creating a new digital divide.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 工具的可及性拉大了初创公司和传统企业之间的差距，制造了新的数字鸿沟。

economy-jobs.en: AI enables division of labor in mathematics, allowing specialization like other sciences.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 使数学中的劳动分工成为可能，像其他科学一样实现专业化。

economy-jobs.en: Education must shift from homework to project-based assessment and teach verification skills.
economy-jobs.zh: 教育必须从作业转向基于项目的评估，并教授验证技能。

economy-jobs.en: Weak students use AI more, while strong students avoid it to prevent skill atrophy.
economy-jobs.zh: 弱学生更多使用 AI，而强学生为避免技能退化而回避它。

economy-jobs.en: Language models can revolutionize education in local languages across Africa.
economy-jobs.zh: 语言模型可以彻底改变非洲各地本地语言的教育。

economy-jobs.en: Over-reliance on AI coding erodes human competence and organizational knowledge over time.
economy-jobs.zh: 过度依赖 AI 编码会逐渐侵蚀人类能力和组织知识。

economy-jobs.en: AI coding tools create an illusion of control similar to slot machines, not genuine productivity.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 编码工具制造类似老虎机的控制幻觉，而非真正的生产力。

economy-jobs.en: Current AI-generated code is often unmaintainable and no one understands it fully.
economy-jobs.zh: 当前 AI 生成的代码常常不可维护，且无人完全理解。

economy-jobs.en: The traditional design process of research, diverge, converge is dead due to AI.
economy-jobs.zh: 传统的设计流程（研究、发散、收敛）因 AI 而消亡。

economy-jobs.en: Designers now spend 30-40% of time mocking up, down from 60-70%.
economy-jobs.zh: 设计师现在花 30-40%的时间做原型，低于之前的 60-70%。

economy-jobs.en: Designers must help engineers execute, not just hand off mocks.
economy-jobs.zh: 设计师必须帮助工程师执行，而不仅仅是交付原型。

economy-jobs.en: AI will amplify human intelligence, similar to the printing press or internet.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 将增强人类智能，类似于印刷术或互联网。

economy-jobs.en: Humans will need more education, not less, as AI advances.
economy-jobs.zh: 随着 AI 进步，人类需要更多教育，而非更少。

economy-jobs.en: Data is the new oil; governments should treat healthcare and national security data as strategic assets.
economy-jobs.zh: 数据是新的石油；政府应将医疗和国家安全数据视为战略资产。

economy-jobs.en: Education remains crucial for becoming better humans, not just job skills.
economy-jobs.zh: 教育对成为更好的人至关重要，而不仅是职业技能。

economy-jobs.en: Physical jobs like plumbing may be safer than software engineering.
economy-jobs.zh: 管道工等体力工作可能比软件工程更安全。

economy-jobs.en: The one-person billion-dollar startup will create a golden age of B2B SaaS.
economy-jobs.zh: 单人十亿美元初创企业将开启 B2B SaaS 的黄金时代。

economy-jobs.en: Business process automation is a massive, underrated AI opportunity.
economy-jobs.zh: 业务流程自动化是一个巨大且被低估的 AI 机会。

economy-jobs.en: Many AI deployments have negative ROI due to lack of bottom-up adoption.
economy-jobs.zh: 许多 AI 部署因缺乏自下而上的采用而 ROI 为负。

economy-jobs.en: Professional-grade AGI will automate most white-collar tasks within 12-18 months.
economy-jobs.zh: 专业级 AGI 将在 12-18 个月内自动化大多数白领工作。

economy-jobs.en: Programmable factories and self-driving wet labs are the most tractable near-term applications for robot foundation models.
economy-jobs.zh: 可编程工厂和自动驾驶湿实验室是机器人基础模型近期最可行的应用。

economy-jobs.en: The number of intelligent robots will exceed the number of iPhones by 2040.
economy-jobs.zh: 到 2040 年，智能机器人的数量将超过 iPhone 的数量。

economy-jobs.en: Advertising is a proven model to scale consumer AI access; subscriptions alone limit reach.
economy-jobs.zh: 广告是规模化消费者 AI 访问的成熟模式；仅靠订阅会限制覆盖范围。

economy-jobs.en: The AI industry may be overinvesting; enterprise adoption is slow and complex.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 行业可能投资过度；企业采用缓慢且复杂。

economy-jobs.en: Retirement is boring; working is more relaxing than an extended holiday.
economy-jobs.zh: 退休很无聊；工作比长假更让人放松。

economy-jobs.en: Humanoid robots today do not generate real value; they often need human handlers.
economy-jobs.zh: 目前的人形机器人并未产生实际价值；它们通常需要人类操作员。

economy-jobs.en: Value will emerge in industrial settings first, then consumer, by late 2026.
economy-jobs.zh: 价值将首先在工业场景中显现，然后才是消费场景，预计在 2026 年底。

economy-jobs.en: General-purpose robotics may be easier than self-driving due to lower reliability requirements.
economy-jobs.zh: 通用机器人可能比自动驾驶更容易，因为对可靠性的要求更低。

economy-jobs.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
economy-jobs.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 填补空白的通才最有价值。

economy-jobs.en: Hiring managers look for high-slope individuals with intrinsic drive and learning aptitude.
economy-jobs.zh: 招聘经理寻找高成长斜率、有内在驱动力和学习能力的人。

economy-jobs.en: Side projects can outweigh traditional experience if they demonstrate care and skill.
economy-jobs.zh: 如果展示出用心和技能，副项目可以超越传统经验。

economy-jobs.en: AGI will transform society and the economy; we need broad interdisciplinary thinking to navigate the transition.
economy-jobs.zh: AGI 将变革社会和经济；我们需要广泛的跨学科思考来应对转型。

economy-jobs.en: Jobs that are purely cognitive and remote are most at risk; physical jobs like plumbing are safer in the short term.
economy-jobs.zh: 纯认知和远程工作风险最大；体力工作如管道工短期更安全。

economy-jobs.en: 2025 is the year of coding in the enterprise, with meaningful adoption starting.
economy-jobs.zh: 2025 年是企业级编程之年，有意义的采用已经开始。

economy-jobs.en: Science and drug discovery are underhyped AI use cases with huge potential.
economy-jobs.zh: 科学和药物发现是被低估的 AI 用例，潜力巨大。

economy-jobs.en: Cost reduction is critical to unlock massive untapped demand for AI.
economy-jobs.zh: 降低成本是释放大量未开发 AI 需求的关键。

economy-jobs.en: Translation industry grew despite AI advances; trust keeps humans in the loop.
economy-jobs.zh: 尽管 AI 进步，翻译行业仍在增长；信任让人类参与其中。

economy-jobs.en: Long-term equilibrium may require human-AI integration via neural links to maintain participation and control.
economy-jobs.zh: 长期均衡可能需要通过神经链接实现人机融合，以维持参与和控制。

economy-jobs.en: The long-run equilibrium may require humans merging with AI via neural links.
economy-jobs.zh: 长期均衡可能需要人类通过神经链接与 AI 融合。

economy-jobs.en: Monetization should benefit creators, rights holders, and OpenAI equally.
economy-jobs.zh: 变现应使创作者、版权方和 OpenAI 平等受益。

economy-jobs.en: Intelligence will become a commodity with cost driven toward zero.
economy-jobs.zh: 智能将成为一种商品，成本趋近于零。

economy-jobs.en: AI can solve tasks humans cannot due to biological limits, like predicting breast cancer from millions of images.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 能解决人类因生物限制无法完成的任务，如从数百万张图像预测乳腺癌。

economy-jobs.en: Private insider information becomes more valuable as public knowledge becomes cheap.
economy-jobs.zh: 随着公共知识变得廉价，私人内幕信息变得更有价值。

economy-jobs.en: AI will merge roles; everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 将融合角色；每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

economy-jobs.en: AI models will enter a price war, eroding margins; only two or three companies will thrive.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 模型将陷入价格战，利润率被侵蚀；只有两三家能蓬勃发展。

economy-jobs.en: Coding is the most tractable domain for AI due to verifiability and replayability, driving near-term economic impact.
economy-jobs.zh: 由于可验证性和可重放性，编程是 AI 最易处理的领域，推动近期经济影响。

economy-jobs.en: Robots will gradually become more useful, similar to how AI tools have enhanced productivity.
economy-jobs.zh: 机器人将逐渐变得更加有用，类似于 AI 工具如何提升生产力。

economy-jobs.en: The future will see humans and robots collaborating symbiotically, not replacing each other.
economy-jobs.zh: 未来人类与机器人将共生协作，而非相互替代。

economy-jobs.en: In a future of abundance, people will find meaning in creative pursuits, not just leisure.
economy-jobs.zh: 在富足的未来，人们将在创造性追求中找到意义，而不仅仅是休闲。

economy-jobs.en: Software engineering demand will increase due to Jevons paradox, not decrease.
economy-jobs.zh: 由于杰文斯悖论，软件工程需求将增加，而非减少。

economy-jobs.en: AI will not eliminate software engineers; it will increase their numbers and change their role.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 不会消灭软件工程师；它将增加其数量并改变其角色。

economy-jobs.en: Designers must learn AI to stay relevant; it's a 10x multiplier.
economy-jobs.zh: 设计师必须学习 AI 以保持相关性；这是 10 倍的加速器。

economy-jobs.en: The future designer is a 'design architect' who controls AI collaborators.
economy-jobs.zh: 未来的设计师是'设计架构师'，控制 AI 协作者。

economy-jobs.en: AI tools should enhance workflows, not replace roles like PMs or engineers.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 工具应增强工作流程，而非取代产品经理或工程师等角色。

economy-jobs.en: AI tools like AlphaFold help scientists work faster, not replace them.
economy-jobs.zh: 像 AlphaFold 这样的 AI 工具帮助科学家更快地工作，而非取代他们。

economy-jobs.en: Industry labs can produce top-tier science and recruit great scientists.
economy-jobs.zh: 工业实验室可以产出顶尖科学并招募优秀科学家。

economy-jobs.en: Building products that don't quite work yet is recommended due to rapid AI improvement.
economy-jobs.zh: 由于 AI 快速进步，建议构建尚未完全可行的产品。

economy-jobs.en: AI integration bottleneck is speed of development, not lack of capability.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 集成的瓶颈是发展速度，而非能力不足。

economy-jobs.en: The equilibrium state may never arrive as AI keeps improving rapidly.
economy-jobs.zh: 由于 AI 持续快速进步，均衡状态可能永远不会到来。

economy-jobs.en: Economic Turing test: AI passes when hired for a job without knowing it's a machine.
economy-jobs.zh: 经济图灵测试：当 AI 被雇佣从事某项工作而不知其为机器时，即通过测试。

economy-jobs.en: Even AI researchers like Ben are not immune to job replacement; all jobs will be affected.
economy-jobs.zh: 即使是像 Ben 这样的 AI 研究人员也无法避免被取代；所有工作都将受到影响。

economy-jobs.en: In a post-singularity world, capitalism may look completely different due to abundance.
economy-jobs.zh: 在后奇点世界，由于物质极大丰富，资本主义可能面目全非。

economy-jobs.en: Over-specialization in tech roles is becoming obsolete; AI levels the field for builders of all backgrounds.
economy-jobs.zh: 技术角色的过度专业化正在过时；AI 为各种背景的构建者提供了公平的竞争环境。

economy-jobs.en: Model providers can't run away with a category; commoditization is near.
economy-jobs.zh: 模型提供商无法在某个类别中遥遥领先；商品化即将到来。

economy-jobs.en: By 2027-2028, models will likely automate any white-collar job.
economy-jobs.zh: 到 2027-2028 年，模型可能自动化任何白领工作。

economy-jobs.en: Taste and logic design skills will become more valuable than carefulness in software engineering.
economy-jobs.zh: 在软件工程中，品味和逻辑设计技能将比谨慎更加重要。

economy-jobs.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and will take decades to unfold.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 的转变将比互联网更具影响力，并将持续数十年。

economy-jobs.en: The IDE market is much bigger than past editor markets because AI enables far more value creation.
economy-jobs.zh: IDE 市场比过去的编辑器市场大得多，因为 AI 能创造更多价值。

economy-jobs.en: Hiring machine learning experts with no biology background can be an asset.
economy-jobs.zh: 招聘没有生物学背景的机器学习专家可能是一种资产。

economy-jobs.en: Future clinical trials may change radically as AI predicts toxicity and efficacy.
economy-jobs.zh: 随着 AI 预测毒性和疗效，未来的临床试验可能发生根本性变化。

economy-jobs.en: AI will transform education, enabling personalized learning for children.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 将变革教育，实现儿童个性化学习。

economy-jobs.en: Inference costs are so low that task-specific models are unnecessary for high-value domains.
economy-jobs.zh: 推理成本极低，高价值领域无需专用模型。

economy-jobs.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will be far beyond trillion-dollar products.
economy-jobs.zh: AGI 被低估；其经济影响将远超万亿美元产品。

economy-jobs.en: Soft skills like creativity, listening, and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills.
economy-jobs.zh: 随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听和管理等软技能变得更加宝贵。

economy-jobs.en: AI's social and emotional jobs may be as important as functional productivity gains.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 的社会和情感功能可能与功能性生产力提升同样重要。

economy-jobs.en: AI coding tools made the guest 1.5x more productive, much higher than expected.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 编码工具使嘉宾的效率提高了 1.5 倍，远高于预期。

economy-jobs.en: Data attribution could enable fair compensation for content creators and improve data quality.
economy-jobs.zh: 数据归因可以为内容创作者提供公平补偿并提高数据质量。

economy-jobs.en: AI will augment rather than replace human jobs, as seen historically with computerization.
economy-jobs.zh: AI 将增强而非取代人类工作，正如历史上计算机化所展现的。

economy-jobs.en: Deploying LLMs in medicine and law carries major risks due to over-reliance and hidden failures.
economy-jobs.zh: 在医学和法律领域部署大语言模型存在重大风险，因为过度依赖和隐藏的失败。

economy-jobs.en: GPT-4's coding ability is superhuman, passing mock interviews faster than all humans.
economy-jobs.zh: GPT-4 的编程能力超乎人类，在模拟面试中比所有人类都快。

economy-jobs.en: GPT-4's intelligence is useful daily; it changes workflows regardless of definition.
economy-jobs.zh: GPT-4 的智能在日常工作中很有用；无论如何定义，它都在改变工作流程。

architecture.en: The transformer architecture is a bottleneck; new architectures are needed for further progress.
architecture.zh: Transformer 架构是瓶颈；需要新架构来取得进一步进展。

architecture.en: It is very unlikely that the transformer is the optimal architecture for AI.
architecture.zh: Transformer 不太可能是 AI 的最优架构。

architecture.en: Neural operators generalize neural networks to learn mappings between function spaces, enabling predictions at any resolution.
architecture.zh: 神经算子将神经网络推广为学习函数空间之间的映射，从而能够以任意分辨率进行预测。

architecture.en: AI weather models can match traditional physics-based models in accuracy while being tens of thousands of times faster.
architecture.zh: AI 天气模型在准确性上可与传统基于物理的模型相媲美，同时速度快数万倍。

architecture.en: Incorporating domain structure, such as spherical geometry, is crucial for stable long-term climate modeling.
architecture.zh: 融入领域结构（如球形几何）对于稳定的长期气候建模至关重要。

architecture.en: Robot foundation models trained on real embodied data can better absorb other data sources like human videos.
architecture.zh: 基于真实具身数据训练的机器人基础模型能更好地吸收其他数据源，如人类视频。

architecture.en: For robotics, start with robot data and add human video on top, not the other way around.
architecture.zh: 对于机器人技术，应从机器人数据开始，再叠加人类视频，而不是相反。

architecture.en: The dividing line between AI and controls is whether you must account for the environment outside the robot.
architecture.zh: AI 与控制的分界线在于是否必须考虑机器人外部环境。

architecture.en: The brain is literally a computer, and solving computational problems by arranging matter is the key to medical breakthroughs.
architecture.zh: 大脑本质上是一台计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

architecture.en: The Platonic representation hypothesis suggests AI models and brains share similar internal representations, guiding practical applications.
architecture.zh: 柏拉图表示假说表明 AI 模型和大脑共享相似的内部表示，指导实际应用。

architecture.en: The brain is a computer, contrary to popular belief, and this view is essential for progress.
architecture.zh: 大脑是计算机，与普遍看法相反，这一观点对进步至关重要。

architecture.en: Multimodal models trained from the start are superior, as they can handle text, images, audio, and video more effectively.
architecture.zh: 从一开始就进行多模态训练的模型更优越，因为它们能更有效地处理文本、图像、音频和视频。

architecture.en: Quantum computing is the next frontier technology that Washington will prioritize.
architecture.zh: 量子计算是华盛顿将优先考虑的下一个前沿技术。

architecture.en: Real estate is a key part of the physical AI tech stack, often underappreciated.
architecture.zh: 房地产是物理 AI 技术栈的关键部分，常常被低估。

architecture.en: The agent harness, not the model, is the primary driver of cost and capability.
architecture.zh: 智能体框架而非模型是成本和能力的主要驱动因素。

architecture.en: The hardest problem in robotics is building truly intelligent systems, not manufacturing.
architecture.zh: 机器人领域最难的问题是构建真正智能的系统，而不是制造。

architecture.en: The next generation of AI devices will replace phones and computers, requiring radical redesign.
architecture.zh: 下一代 AI 设备将取代手机和电脑，需要彻底重新设计。

architecture.en: Glasses are one of the worst products, and the end state is BCI, not wearables.
architecture.zh: 眼镜是最差的产品之一，最终形态是脑机接口，而不是可穿戴设备。

architecture.en: Concepts in neural networks form geometric shapes, like manifolds, which are often clean and low-dimensional, aiding interpretability.
architecture.zh: 神经网络中的概念形成几何形状，如流形，通常干净且低维，有助于可解释性。

architecture.en: Sparse autoencoders fragment manifolds, making concepts appear disconnected; seeing the whole shape is necessary for effective intervention.
architecture.zh: 稀疏自编码器碎片化流形，使概念显得不连贯；看到整体形状对于有效干预是必要的。

architecture.en: Analogizing neural networks to brains is surprisingly helpful, even if architectures differ, and it keeps working in practice.
architecture.zh: 将神经网络类比大脑出奇地有用，即使架构不同，在实践中也持续有效。

architecture.en: Memory at multiple time scales enables robots to perform long, non-repetitive tasks autonomously.
architecture.zh: 多时间尺度的记忆使机器人能够自主执行长时间、非重复的任务。

architecture.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists on downstream tasks.
architecture.zh: 单个通用模型在下游任务上可以匹配或超越微调后的专用模型。

architecture.en: AI erases the API line, enabling bidirectional communication between humans and systems.
architecture.zh: AI 消除了 API 界限，实现人与系统间的双向沟通。

architecture.en: Aligning training and serving stacks is critical to avoid quality drops due to numerical differences.
architecture.zh: 对齐训练和服务栈至关重要，以避免因数值差异导致的质量下降。

architecture.en: The future may see millions of specialized models, one per application use case, not just a few frontier models.
architecture.zh: 未来可能出现数百万个专用模型，每个应用用例一个，而不仅仅是少数前沿模型。

architecture.en: Separating planning from rendering, as in the R2C2 framework, can simplify complex image generation tasks.
architecture.zh: 像 R2C2 框架那样将规划与渲染分离，可以简化复杂的图像生成任务。

architecture.en: Running diffusion models in latent space with patchification enables high-resolution image generation on memory-limited devices.
architecture.zh: 在潜在空间中使用分块处理运行扩散模型，可以在内存受限的设备上生成高分辨率图像。

architecture.en: Inpainting models can avoid boundary artifacts by using inverted noise from the input image instead of random noise.
architecture.zh: 修复模型通过使用输入图像的反演噪声而非随机噪声，可以避免边界伪影。

architecture.en: Intel must focus on product excellence, including CPU, GPU, and system architecture, to regain leadership.
architecture.zh: 英特尔必须专注于产品卓越性，包括 CPU、GPU 和系统架构，以重获领导地位。

architecture.en: Advanced packaging and high-speed connectivity are critical for future performance and efficiency.
architecture.zh: 先进封装和高速互联对未来性能和效率至关重要。

architecture.en: Memory, once a commodity, is now ripe for innovation and new architectures.
architecture.zh: 内存曾是商品，现在创新和新架构的时机已成熟。

architecture.en: The future of drug discovery is moving from a waterfall model to an agile loop, enabled by AI models that can quickly generate and validate promising candidates.
architecture.zh: 药物发现的未来正从瀑布模型转向敏捷循环，AI 模型能够快速生成和验证有前景的候选药物。

architecture.en: Antibodies are a challenging but tractable target for AI design due to their general framework and the ability to precisely engineer binding loops.
architecture.zh: 抗体因其通用框架和精确工程化结合环的能力，成为 AI 设计具有挑战性但可处理的目标。

architecture.en: The ultimate goal is to one-shot generate drug-like molecules directly from models, reducing the need for extensive hit-to-lead optimization.
architecture.zh: 最终目标是从模型直接一次性生成类药分子，减少对广泛先导化合物优化的需求。

architecture.en: AI training will remain on the ground, but AI inference will be in space.
architecture.zh: AI 训练将保留在地面，但 AI 推理将在太空进行。

architecture.en: Building high-quality benchmarks is essential for training and evaluating models, especially in specialized domains like legal.
architecture.zh: 构建高质量的基准测试对于训练和评估模型至关重要，尤其是在法律等专业领域。

architecture.en: Synthetic data generation guided by domain experts is a key method to create training data without using sensitive customer data.
architecture.zh: 由领域专家指导的合成数据生成是在不使用敏感客户数据的情况下创建训练数据的关键方法。

architecture.en: Post-training open-source models can achieve frontier-level performance on specific tasks, making it a viable strategy.
architecture.zh: 对开源模型进行后训练可以在特定任务上达到前沿水平，使其成为一种可行策略。

architecture.en: Deep architectures have an implicit bias to build coarse-grained variables, enabling creativity from few examples.
architecture.zh: 深层架构具有构建粗粒度变量的隐式偏差，从而能够从少量示例中实现创造力。

architecture.en: The world has a hierarchical structure, and learning abstractions is key to overcoming the curse of dimensionality.
architecture.zh: 世界具有层级结构，学习抽象是克服维度灾难的关键。

architecture.en: Predicting in latent space is more sample-efficient than predicting in token space.
architecture.zh: 在潜在空间中进行预测比在词元空间中进行预测更具样本效率。

architecture.en: Context matters more than intelligence as we approach AGI; AI employees need rich shared context to be useful.
architecture.zh: 随着我们接近 AGI，上下文比智能更重要；AI 员工需要丰富的共享上下文才能有用。

architecture.en: Fine-tuning is a last resort; most companies should avoid it and rely on prompting and context management.
architecture.zh: 微调是最后手段；大多数公司应避免微调，而依赖提示词和上下文管理。

architecture.en: Memory may eventually live in weights via per-user LoRA, not just in context files.
architecture.zh: 记忆最终可能通过每用户 LoRA 存储在权重中，而不仅限于上下文文件。

architecture.en: Vision is a cornerstone of intelligence, both in evolution and in AI, with half of cortical activity involved in visual function.
architecture.zh: 视觉是智能的基石，无论是在进化中还是在人工智能中，大脑皮层活动的一半都涉及视觉功能。

architecture.en: Scientific discovery is a promising area for AI, enabling cross-disciplinary synthesis and accelerating medical breakthroughs.
architecture.zh: 科学发现是人工智能的一个有前景的领域，能够实现跨学科综合并加速医学突破。

architecture.en: AI's creativity, like AlphaGo's Move 37, is real but limited to well-defined domains with clear rules.
architecture.zh: 人工智能的创造力，如 AlphaGo 的第 37 步，是真实的，但仅限于规则明确的领域。

architecture.en: The future of AI is multi-model, and no single model will dominate the entire market.
architecture.zh: AI 的未来是多模型并存的，没有任何单一模型能够主导整个市场。

architecture.en: Companies should build their own specialized models and use routers to access a diverse ecosystem of models.
architecture.zh: 公司应构建自己的专用模型，并使用路由器访问多样化的模型生态系统。

architecture.en: Memory will be owned by multiple layers, not just the model, and apps hold valuable context.
architecture.zh: 记忆将由多个层拥有，而不仅仅是模型，应用拥有宝贵的上下文。

architecture.en: Most of a model's knowledge comes from pre-training; post-training mostly reinforces existing capabilities.
architecture.zh: 模型的大部分知识来自预训练；后训练主要是强化已有的能力。

architecture.en: Steering along learned manifolds is far more effective than naive linear interpolation.
architecture.zh: 沿学习到的流形进行引导远比朴素的线性插值有效。

architecture.en: Models represent emotions as a wheel; steering along this geometry consistently adjusts emotional output.
architecture.zh: 模型将情绪表示为轮盘；沿此几何结构引导能一致地调整情绪输出。

architecture.en: The fixation on tokens will go away; we never talked about CPU cycles, and we will stop talking about tokens in a few years.
architecture.zh: 对代币的过度关注将会消失；我们从不谈论 CPU 周期，几年后我们也将不再谈论代币。

architecture.en: The goal is to make drug discovery more like engineering, with abstraction layers similar to code.
architecture.zh: 目标是将药物发现变得更像工程学，拥有类似于代码的抽象层。

architecture.en: Biology is more verifiable than code generation; objective readouts exist for molecules.
architecture.zh: 生物学比代码生成更可验证；分子存在客观读数。

architecture.en: Antibody design was thought impossible due to data scarcity, but it's now achievable.
architecture.zh: 由于数据稀缺，抗体设计曾被认为不可能，但现在已可实现。

architecture.en: HTML is the only document type that matters, as it enables interactive and dynamic artifacts beyond static forms.
architecture.zh: HTML 是唯一重要的文档类型，因为它能实现超越静态形式的交互式和动态产物。

architecture.en: Weak sensing leads to a safety curve that flattens too early; multiple modalities are necessary for superhuman performance.
architecture.zh: 弱感知导致安全曲线过早平坦；多种模态对于超人性能是必要的。

architecture.en: Post-training is more of an art than a science, involving human judgment and choices.
architecture.zh: 后训练更像是一门艺术而非科学，涉及人类判断和选择。

architecture.en: Diverse benchmarks are needed to evaluate subjective qualities like creative writing and emotional intelligence.
architecture.zh: 需要多样化的基准来评估创造性写作和情商等主观品质。

architecture.en: Benchmarks should be continuous, not fixed, to keep pace with model capabilities.
architecture.zh: 基准应该是持续的，而不是固定的，以跟上模型能力的发展。

architecture.en: Inference optimizations like KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless, while quantization is the main lossy optimization.
architecture.zh: KV 缓存和投机解码等推理优化是无损的，而量化是主要的有损优化。

architecture.en: Supporting a new model for production requires significant work including quantization, speculative decoder training, and infrastructure setup.
architecture.zh: 为生产环境支持一个新模型需要大量工作，包括量化、投机解码器训练和基础设施搭建。

architecture.en: The industry is moving towards disaggregated prefill and decode, with KV cache management becoming increasingly important.
architecture.zh: 行业正朝着预填充和解码分离的方向发展，KV 缓存管理变得越来越重要。

architecture.en: Simulation models should represent human values, preferences, and taste, not super-rational intelligence.
architecture.zh: 模拟模型应代表人类的价值观、偏好和品味，而非超级理性智能。

architecture.en: The value of simulation lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not just prediction.
architecture.zh: 模拟的价值在于反事实推理和塑造未来，而不仅仅是预测。

architecture.en: People don't really care about prediction; they care about shaping the future.
architecture.zh: 人们并不真正关心预测；他们关心的是塑造未来。

architecture.en: The next frontier for AI is moving beyond verifiable domains like coding and math into non-verifiable areas, requiring new training methods and longer time horizons.
architecture.zh: AI 的下一个前沿是从编码和数学等可验证领域转向不可验证领域，这需要新的训练方法和更长的时间跨度。

architecture.en: Running frontier models locally on personal devices is feasible and could offer better latency and privacy than data-center-based inference.
architecture.zh: 在个人设备上本地运行前沿模型是可行的，并且可能比基于数据中心的推理提供更低的延迟和更好的隐私。

architecture.en: Context engineering — skills, clear specs, and retrieval — is central to getting capable models to do real work.
architecture.zh: 上下文工程——技能、清晰规格和检索——是让强大模型真正完成实际工作的核心。

architecture.en: We can build useful AI systems from unreliable components, questioning the assumption that transistors must never fail.
architecture.zh: 我们可以用不可靠的组件构建有用的 AI 系统，质疑晶体管绝不能出错这一假设。

architecture.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation, requiring a new architecture.
architecture.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应方面存在局限，需要新的架构。

architecture.en: Going all-in on 'word cell' is a mistake; systems thinking and a philosophical compass are still essential.
architecture.zh: 全力押注“文字脑”是错误的；系统思维和哲学罗盘仍然必不可少。

architecture.en: Robotics ChatGPT moment is 2-3 years away, not decades.
architecture.zh: 机器人领域的 ChatGPT 时刻将在 2-3 年内到来，而非数十年。

architecture.en: Benchmarks can be solved, but real-world tasks are amorphous.
architecture.zh: 基准测试可以解决，但现实任务难以界定。

architecture.en: Trained model weights can be treated as data, enabling analysis and generation of new models.
architecture.zh: 训练好的模型权重可以被视为数据，从而能够分析和生成新模型。

architecture.en: Weight space learning can predict model properties like accuracy without test data.
architecture.zh: 权重空间学习可以在没有测试数据的情况下预测模型属性，如准确率。

architecture.en: Generating models from weights can replace pre-training for specific tasks, saving compute.
architecture.zh: 从权重生成模型可以替代特定任务的预训练，节省算力。

architecture.en: Nvidia's core insight is accelerating algorithm domains, not just building chips.
architecture.zh: Nvidia 的核心洞见是加速算法领域，而不仅仅是构建芯片。

architecture.en: AI is a universal function approximator that will reinvent the computing stack.
architecture.zh: AI 是一种通用函数逼近器，将重塑整个计算栈。

architecture.en: Wafer-scale chips with massive SRAM cut weight-moving time, making them far faster for inference than GPUs.
architecture.zh: 带有海量 SRAM 的晶圆级芯片减少了权重移动时间，使其在推理上远快于 GPU。

architecture.en: GPUs are fundamentally slow at inference because moving weights from HBM dominates; Cerebras is about 2500x faster.
architecture.zh: GPU 在推理上本质很慢，因为从 HBM 移动权重占主导；Cerebras 大约快 2500 倍。

architecture.en: Hardcoding model architectures into chips is a structural mistake; accelerate underlying sparse linear algebra instead.
architecture.zh: 把模型架构硬编码进芯片是结构性错误；应加速底层的稀疏线性代数。

architecture.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, is a framework that guides long-term vision and innovation.
architecture.zh: 数字化物理世界，将原子视为比特，是指导长期愿景和创新的框架。

architecture.en: The physical world is more interesting for AI than the digital one because it has more variables and stochastic distributions, requiring empirical understanding.
architecture.zh: 物理世界对 AI 来说比数字世界更有趣，因为它有更多的变量和随机分布，需要经验理解。

architecture.en: Alphabet remains committed to frontier model development with Gemini 4 pre-training showing promising progress.
architecture.zh: Alphabet 仍致力于前沿模型开发，Gemini 4 的预训练显示出有希望的进展。

architecture.en: Gemini Flash models are prioritized for cost-performance, while frontier leadership requires larger base models like Gemini 4.
architecture.zh: Gemini Flash 模型优先考虑性价比，而前沿领导力需要更大的基础模型，如 Gemini 4。

architecture.en: Tool-call layers like MCP are stupid; models should just write code directly in a virtual machine instead of calling dozens of tools.
architecture.zh: 像 MCP 这种工具调用层很愚蠢；模型应该直接在虚拟机里写代码，而不是调用几十个工具。

architecture.en: AI models like GPT-5.5 Pro have crossed the threshold of biological intuition, predicting experimental outcomes with near 100% accuracy.
architecture.zh: 像 GPT-5.5 Pro 这样的 AI 模型已跨越生物直觉的门槛，能以接近 100% 的准确率预测实验结果。

architecture.en: Diffusion language models outperform autoregressive models for predicting perturbation responses.
architecture.zh: 扩散语言模型在预测扰动反应方面优于自回归模型。

architecture.en: Incorporating diverse biological priors improves generalization to unseen cell types.
architecture.zh: 整合多样化的生物学先验知识提高了对未见细胞类型的泛化能力。

architecture.en: Virtual cell models can generalize to unseen contexts, enabling predictions in primary cells and complex systems.
architecture.zh: 虚拟细胞模型可以泛化到未见情境，从而在原代细胞和复杂系统中进行预测。

architecture.en: Building a multi-model harness outperforms model-specific harnesses.
architecture.zh: 构建多模型工具链优于特定模型的工具链。

architecture.en: Model-harness co-design does not yield better performance; multi-model harnesses do.
architecture.zh: 模型与工具链协同设计不会带来更好性能；多模型工具链才行。

architecture.en: World models are evolving from physics-based simulation to neural simulation, enabling more efficient training of physical AI.
architecture.zh: 世界模型正从基于物理的模拟演变为神经模拟，使物理 AI 的训练更加高效。

architecture.en: The future will see millions of specialized models, one per application or use case.
architecture.zh: 未来将有数百万个专用模型，每个应用或用例一个。

architecture.en: The command line interface was a stopgap, not the final form.
architecture.zh: 命令行界面是权宜之计，而非最终形态。

architecture.en: Programming languages may become largely irrelevant for AI-generated code.
architecture.zh: 对于 AI 生成的代码，编程语言可能变得基本无关紧要。

architecture.en: AI's hallucinations can be valuable for creative inspiration, especially in image generation.
architecture.zh: AI 的幻觉对创意灵感有价值，尤其是在图像生成方面。

architecture.en: Smarter models require fewer instructions and examples; leaner system prompts boost performance.
architecture.zh: 更智能的模型需要更少的指令和示例；精简的系统提示可提升性能。

architecture.en: Shorter, principle-driven prompts often work better than detailed rules and examples.
architecture.zh: 简短、基于原则的提示通常比详细的规则和示例更有效。

architecture.en: Excessive constraints can hinder performance; providing reasons is more effective than absolute prohibitions.
architecture.zh: 过多约束会阻碍性能；提供理由比绝对禁止更有效。

architecture.en: Small language models deliver efficient, private, on-device intelligence for physical-world applications.
architecture.zh: 小型语言模型为物理世界应用提供高效、私密、设备端的智能。

architecture.en: Liquid AI's architecture is not purely post-Transformer; it uses automated search over many architectures.
architecture.zh: Liquid AI 的架构并非纯粹的 Transformer 后架构；它使用自动化搜索遍历多种架构。

architecture.en: A general scientific reasoning model beats domain-specific models due to cross-domain transfer.
architecture.zh: 通用科学推理模型因跨领域迁移而胜过专用模型。

architecture.en: AI is now assisting in chip design, and recursion where AI designs its own hardware is near.
architecture.zh: AI 正在辅助芯片设计，AI 设计自身硬件的递归时代即将到来。

architecture.en: Jalapeno chips optimize tokens per watt, leveraging knowledge of future models for efficiency.
architecture.zh: Jalapeno 芯片优化每瓦特 token 数，利用对未来模型的了解提升效率。

architecture.en: Retrofitting reliability onto LLMs via post-hoc checks or rigid workflows is insufficient; reliability must be architected in.
architecture.zh: 通过事后检查或刚性工作流为 LLM 改造可靠性是不够的；可靠性必须内建于架构中。

architecture.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks.
architecture.zh: 内建可靠性的专业模型在企业任务上可能优于通用模型。

architecture.en: Large language models alone cannot achieve AGI; they need to be combined with world models and controllers.
architecture.zh: 仅靠大型语言模型无法实现 AGI；它们需要与世界模型和控制器结合。

architecture.en: Platform abstraction layers: knowledge, execution, coordination.
architecture.zh: 平台抽象层：知识、执行、协调。

architecture.en: Token jobs and strategies are key for maximizing intelligence per dollar.
architecture.zh: Token 的任务和策略是最大化每美元智能的关键。

architecture.en: Model routing and cost optimization are natural next steps after token maxing.
architecture.zh: 模型路由和成本优化是 Token 最大化后的自然下一步。

architecture.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks.
architecture.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；用更少做更多才能解决更难的长期任务。

architecture.en: Models should learn autonomously what to store in weights vs. text, with user feedback but not dependence.
architecture.zh: 模型应自主决定哪些知识存入权重、哪些保留文本，用户反馈可学习但不依赖。

architecture.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale.
architecture.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——即使达到千万级，更多 token 也会降低准确性。

architecture.en: Memory systems are all hacks; true memory should be in latent space.
architecture.zh: 所有记忆系统都是权宜之计；真正的记忆应在潜在空间中。

architecture.en: Memory in AI should be holistic across time scales, not just storage.
architecture.zh: AI 中的记忆应跨时间尺度整体考虑，而不仅仅是存储。

architecture.en: The industry over-indexes on chatbots; real-time interaction is a paradigm shift.
architecture.zh: 行业过度关注聊天机器人；实时交互才是范式转变。

architecture.en: Chain-of-thought reasoning is a powerful but fragile interpretability tool; it may not work for future models.
architecture.zh: 思维链推理是一个强大但脆弱的可解释性工具；未来模型可能不再适用。

architecture.en: Chain-of-thought may be less useful for future models that can think internally without verbalizing.
architecture.zh: 思维链对未来能内部思考而不言语化的模型可能用处不大。

architecture.en: Probes and sparse autoencoders are key white-box techniques for understanding model internals.
architecture.zh: 探针和稀疏自编码器是理解模型内部的关键白盒技术。

architecture.en: True AGI requires physical robots with hardware rivaling human bodies, not just software behind a screen.
architecture.zh: 真正的 AGI 需要硬件能与人体媲美的物理机器人，而不仅仅是屏幕后的软件。

architecture.en: Current large language models are heavily biased toward human data, limiting their generality.
architecture.zh: 当前大语言模型严重偏向人类数据，限制了其通用性。

architecture.en: Algorithms don't have deep semantic understanding; they use embeddings not legible to humans.
architecture.zh: 算法没有深层的语义理解；它们使用人类无法解读的嵌入。

architecture.en: The jagged frontier of AI capabilities is evolving; reasoning models have closed gaps in math and logic, but weaknesses remain in areas like long-form fiction.
architecture.zh: AI 能力的锯齿状前沿正在演变；推理模型已缩小了数学和逻辑方面的差距，但在长篇虚构写作等领域仍有弱点。

architecture.en: Taste is not a unique human advantage; AI can exercise judgment, and the bottleneck is task complexity on the jagged frontier, not human-only traits.
architecture.zh: 品味并非人类独有优势；AI 也能进行判断，瓶颈是锯齿状前沿上的任务复杂性，而非人类独有的特质。

architecture.en: Speculative decoding with block-based draft models can give 2-4x speedup without quality loss.
architecture.zh: 基于块的推测解码草案模型可以在不损失质量的情况下实现 2-4 倍的加速。

architecture.en: Smell is a high-dimensional problem with over 300 olfactory receptor types, far more than color's three channels.
architecture.zh: 嗅觉是一个高维问题，有超过 300 种嗅觉受体类型，远超颜色的三个通道。

architecture.en: The Principal Odor Map is a continuous predictive map of smell, foundational for olfactory AI.
architecture.zh: 主气味图是嗅觉的连续预测地图，是嗅觉 AI 的基础。

architecture.en: A Copernican view of intelligence suggests AI should incorporate non-human forms like chemical communication.
architecture.zh: 智能的哥白尼观点认为 AI 应纳入非人类形式，如化学通信。

architecture.en: Neural networks can learn representations without explicit human rules.
architecture.zh: 神经网络无需人类显式规则即可学习表征。

architecture.en: Next-token prediction is a powerful approach to building intelligence.
architecture.zh: 下一个词预测是构建智能的强大方法。

architecture.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone of Liquid AI's research, maximizing intelligence in the smallest algorithm format.
architecture.zh: 效率是 Liquid AI 研究的基石，以最小的算法格式最大化智能。

architecture.en: General AI models will beat specialized ones, making vertical SaaS obsolete by 2027.
architecture.zh: 通用 AI 模型将击败专用模型，使垂直 SaaS 在 2027 年前过时。

architecture.en: The future of interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting, with new interfaces.
architecture.zh: 与模型交互的未来将超越提示，出现新的界面。

architecture.en: We are still in a prompting age, but there are other ways to explore latent space.
architecture.zh: 我们仍处于提示时代，但还有其他探索潜在空间的方法。

architecture.en: Neuralink's first versions will treat brain injuries like restoring sight, hearing, and limb function.
architecture.zh: Neuralink 早期版本将治疗脑损伤，如恢复视力、听力和肢体功能。

architecture.en: AI symbiosis via high-bandwidth brain interface is needed to keep humans relevant as AI advances.
architecture.zh: 随着 AI 进步，人类需要通过高带宽脑机接口实现共生才能不被淘汰。

architecture.en: Nvidia builds NeMo Tron to understand AI deeply for future systems and to support the ecosystem.
architecture.zh: Nvidia 构建 NeMo Tron 是为了深入理解 AI 以设计未来系统，并支持生态系统。

architecture.en: Hybrid architectures combining state space models and transformers produce smarter models than either alone.
architecture.zh: 结合状态空间模型和 Transformer 的混合架构比单独使用任何一种都能产生更智能的模型。

architecture.en: Models are not commoditized; smarter models unlock transformative scientific breakthroughs.
architecture.zh: 模型并非商品化；更智能的模型能带来变革性的科学突破。

architecture.en: LLM architectures are relatively boring; drug discovery models offer more diverse and interesting architectural challenges.
architecture.zh: LLM 架构相对乏味；药物发现模型提供了更多样化和有趣的架构挑战。

architecture.en: AI's role in mathematics may shift from theorem proving to curation and explanation.
architecture.zh: AI 在数学中的角色可能从定理证明转向策展和解释。

architecture.en: The next benchmark for AI in math is generating interesting conjectures and definitions.
architecture.zh: AI 在数学中的下一个基准是生成有趣的猜想和定义。

architecture.en: Lean formalization may be overrated for current AI math progress; natural language works.
architecture.zh: Lean 形式化对当前 AI 数学进步可能被高估；自然语言同样有效。

architecture.en: LLMs understand language similarly to humans, via feature vectors, not symbolic logic.
architecture.zh: 大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，与人类类似，而非符号逻辑。

architecture.en: LLMs are not just autocomplete; they genuinely understand questions to answer them.
architecture.zh: 大语言模型不仅仅是自动补全；它们真正理解问题才能回答。

architecture.en: Subjective experience is not an inner qualia theater but a linguistic instruction about hypothetical external states.
architecture.zh: 主观体验不是内在的感质剧场，而是关于假设外部状态的语言指令。

architecture.en: Hardware-software co-design is critical; co-optimizing across model, software, and hardware layers yields multiplicative gains.
architecture.zh: 硬件-软件协同设计至关重要；跨模型、软件和硬件层的联合优化能带来乘数级收益。

architecture.en: CUDA moat is weakening; model companies now write custom kernels for multiple chips, aided by AI coding.
architecture.zh: CUDA 护城河正在减弱；模型公司现在为多种芯片编写自定义内核，借助 AI 编码。

architecture.en: Most AI performance gains in last 3 years came from model layer, not hardware; co-design is key.
architecture.zh: 过去三年 AI 性能提升主要来自模型层，而非硬件；协同设计是关键。

architecture.en: Thermodynamic computing uses inherent noise to perform probabilistic computations efficiently.
architecture.zh: 热力学计算利用固有噪声高效执行概率计算。

architecture.en: Noise is not the enemy in chip design; it can be used for computation.
architecture.zh: 在芯片设计中，噪声并非敌人；它可以用于计算。

architecture.en: LLMs may not need to be truly intelligent; hill climbing with good priors can solve problems.
architecture.zh: LLM 可能不需要真正的智能；利用良好先验的爬山法就能解决问题。

architecture.en: Glasses are the next computing platform, more natural and integrated than phones.
architecture.zh: 眼镜是下一个计算平台，比手机更自然、更融入生活。

architecture.en: Long context windows alone are insufficient; compaction techniques are needed.
architecture.zh: 仅靠长上下文窗口不够；还需要压缩技术。

architecture.en: The best engineers keep in mind the disparate parts of a system and see around corners; frontier models are beginning to exhibit this theory of project.
architecture.zh: 最优秀的工程师会牢记系统的各个部分并预见潜在问题；前沿模型开始展现出这种项目全局观。

architecture.en: Data centers in space, initially seen as crazy, may make sense due to infinite power and land.
architecture.zh: 太空数据中心，最初看似疯狂，但由于无限的能源和土地，可能是有道理的。

architecture.en: Better models alone won't drive mass adoption; product wrapping is key.
architecture.zh: 仅靠更好的模型不会推动大规模采用；产品封装是关键。

architecture.en: Applied AI markets will see innovation from specialized vendors, not just model providers.
architecture.zh: 应用 AI 市场将出现来自专业供应商的创新，而不仅仅是模型提供商。

architecture.en: Unified storage layer (L-TAP) solves HTAP challenges without a single query engine.
architecture.zh: 统一存储层（L-TAP）解决了 HTAP 挑战，无需单一查询引擎。

architecture.en: HTAP done right is not a single engine but unified storage; query engines can remain separate.
architecture.zh: 正确的 HTAP 不是单一引擎，而是统一存储；查询引擎可以保持分离。

architecture.en: Vector databases should not be a separate category; they are just general storage.
architecture.zh: 向量数据库不应成为独立类别；它们只是通用存储。

architecture.en: AGI requires multimodal understanding, including the physical world, not just text.
architecture.zh: AGI 需要多模态理解，包括物理世界，而不仅仅是文本。

architecture.en: AI creativity may stem from visual imagination, not just language models.
architecture.zh: AI 创造力可能源于视觉想象，而不仅仅是语言模型。

architecture.en: The Einstein test for AI creativity requires visual and physical understanding.
architecture.zh: AI 创造力的爱因斯坦测试需要视觉和物理理解。

architecture.en: AI models are intelligent but represent an alien form of intelligence, not human-like.
architecture.zh: AI 模型是智能的，但代表了一种外星形式的智能，而非类人智能。

architecture.en: AlphaFold predicts protein structures in minutes instead of years, revolutionizing structural biology.
architecture.zh: AlphaFold 在几分钟内预测蛋白质结构，取代了以往需要数年的实验，彻底改变了结构生物学。

architecture.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the entire cell.
architecture.zh: AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄预测器，而非整个细胞的模型。

architecture.en: The success of AlphaFold 2 came from many mid-size wins, not one or two breakthroughs.
architecture.zh: AlphaFold 2 的成功来自众多中等规模的胜利，而非一两个突破。

architecture.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across diverse vehicles and environments.
architecture.zh: Transformer 架构使得一个通用的物理 AI 模型能够跨越不同车辆和环境。

architecture.en: Diverse data from different verticals improves physical AI models faster.
architecture.zh: 来自不同垂直领域的多样化数据能更快地改进物理 AI 模型。

architecture.en: Fable's leap is larger than Opus 4.5; Boris ran out of hard problems to give it.
architecture.zh: Fable 的飞跃比 Opus 4.5 更大；Boris 已经找不到难题来测试它了。

architecture.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; combining them is a central challenge for reliable AI.
architecture.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；如何结合两者是构建可靠 AI 的核心挑战。

architecture.en: Evals must evolve from static benchmarks to long-horizon, realistic tasks.
architecture.zh: 评估必须从静态基准演变为长期、现实的任务。

architecture.en: Math training generalizes to other domains like biology.
architecture.zh: 数学训练可以泛化到生物学等其他领域。

architecture.en: Long context is less important than search and tool use.
architecture.zh: 长上下文不如搜索和工具使用重要。

architecture.en: LLM reasoning mimics human reasoning through pattern matching, not true understanding; it's useful but not equivalent.
architecture.zh: LLM 推理通过模式匹配模仿人类推理，而非真正理解；它有用但不等于人类推理。

architecture.en: AI is not always the best solution; classical ML models often outperform LLMs for tasks like fraud detection.
architecture.zh: AI 并非总是最佳方案；经典 ML 模型在欺诈检测等任务上常优于 LLM。

architecture.en: World models are more relevant for robotics and embodied AI than for achieving AGI through language alone.
architecture.zh: 世界模型对机器人和具身 AI 更相关，而非仅通过语言实现 AGI。

architecture.en: Orchestration across models, tools, and devices is key to long-term value in AI.
architecture.zh: 跨模型、工具和设备的编排是 AI 长期价值的关键。

architecture.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create real business value.
architecture.zh: 模型不是产品；编排和智能体框架创造真正的商业价值。

architecture.en: Anthropic is likely to become a major player in life sciences, following its success in coding.
architecture.zh: 继在编码领域取得成功后，Anthropic 很可能成为生命科学领域的重要参与者。

architecture.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
architecture.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；我们现在所称的模型包括智能体框架和工具，而不仅仅是权重。

architecture.en: Omni is a single world model that blurs the line between video and world models, starting with video editing.
architecture.zh: Omni 是一个单一的世界模型，模糊了视频模型和世界模型之间的界限，从视频编辑开始。

architecture.en: AI can transform biology from discovery-based to engineering-based science.
architecture.zh: AI 能将生物学从发现科学转变为工程科学。

architecture.en: Building hierarchical world models from proteins to cells to whole systems is key.
architecture.zh: 构建从蛋白质到细胞再到整个系统的分层世界模型是关键。

architecture.en: AI factories produce intelligence tokens, similar to how dynamos produce electricity.
architecture.zh: AI 工厂生产智能代币，类似于发电机生产电力。

architecture.en: Intelligence is the ability to learn new tasks quickly, not accumulation of knowledge or skills.
architecture.zh: 智能是快速学习新任务的能力，而非知识或技能的积累。

architecture.en: World models should be trained in abstract representation space, not as generative models or video generators.
architecture.zh: 世界模型应在抽象表征空间中训练，而非作为生成模型或视频生成器。

architecture.en: Joint embedding predictive architectures (JEPA) outperform generative models for learning visual representations.
architecture.zh: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）在学习视觉表征方面优于生成模型。

architecture.en: LLMs enable new things that were previously impossible, not just automate old tasks.
architecture.zh: LLM 能实现以前不可能的新事物，而不仅仅是自动化旧任务。

architecture.en: The next iPhone will still need a display; voice-first is the future.
architecture.zh: 下一代 iPhone 仍需要屏幕；语音优先才是未来。

architecture.en: The Erdős disproof was not a math-specific model but a general-purpose reasoning model.
architecture.zh: 厄尔多斯反例并非由数学专用模型得出，而是通用推理模型。

architecture.en: AI can connect distant ideas but still struggles to create entirely new theories.
architecture.zh: AI 能连接遥远的概念，但仍难以创造全新理论。

architecture.en: Decomposing problems for AI can be worse than asking directly due to human blind spots.
architecture.zh: 为 AI 分解问题可能不如直接提问，因为人类有盲点。

architecture.en: AI's creative leaps, like applying class field theory to geometry, surprised experts.
architecture.zh: AI 的创造性飞跃，如将类域论应用于几何，令专家惊讶。

architecture.en: Lean-based systems excel in structured math domains like algebra but struggle in creative areas like combinatorics.
architecture.zh: 基于 Lean 的系统在代数等结构化数学领域表现出色，但在组合数学等创造性领域存在困难。

architecture.en: The future of coding involves combining informal reasoning with formal verification for reliability.
architecture.zh: 编程的未来是将非正式推理与形式验证相结合以确保可靠性。

architecture.en: Mathematical discovery tools are essential for forming conjectures before formal proof.
architecture.zh: 数学发现工具对于在形式证明之前形成猜想至关重要。

architecture.en: True continual learning requires two phases: active input processing and offline memory consolidation.
architecture.zh: 真正的持续学习需要两个阶段：主动输入处理和离线记忆巩固。

architecture.en: Nested learning uses multiple MLP blocks updated at different frequencies to manage memory across timescales.
architecture.zh: 嵌套学习使用不同频率更新的多个 MLP 块来跨时间尺度管理记忆。

architecture.en: Knowledge transfer between fast and slow modules via distillation enables abstraction and prevents catastrophic forgetting.
architecture.zh: 通过蒸馏在快慢模块间传递知识，实现抽象并防止灾难性遗忘。

architecture.en: Current models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans who generalize from few examples.
architecture.zh: 当前模型只有在穷尽表面模式后才学习概念，而人类能从少量例子中泛化。

architecture.en: Multimodal models haven't made deep progress; they still process inputs sequentially like tiny patches.
architecture.zh: 多模态模型尚未取得深层进展，仍像小补丁一样顺序处理输入。

architecture.en: Most video model improvements now come from language models, not diffusion technology.
architecture.zh: 大多数视频模型的改进现在来自语言模型，而非扩散技术。

architecture.en: Training video models requires synthetic text-video pairs due to poor natural alignment online.
architecture.zh: 训练视频模型需要合成文本-视频对，因为在线自然对齐很差。

architecture.en: Step distillation reduces inference steps from 100 to 4-8 by learning from a teacher model.
architecture.zh: 步骤蒸馏通过从教师模型学习，将推理步骤从 100 步减少到 4-8 步。

architecture.en: Separating the agent's brain from the sandbox (out-of-the-box) is the better architecture despite complexity.
architecture.zh: 将智能体的大脑与沙箱分离（盒外架构）是更好的架构，尽管更复杂。

architecture.en: Docker containers are not a true security boundary and cause issues like Docker-in-Docker for real apps.
architecture.zh: Docker 容器并非真正的安全边界，对于真实应用还会导致 Docker 嵌套等问题。

architecture.en: Specialized models outperform generalist models on niche scientific tasks.
architecture.zh: 专业模型在特定科学任务上优于通用模型。

architecture.en: Frontier models have non-overlapping spikes; combining them yields better results than any single model.
architecture.zh: 前沿模型具有非重叠的尖峰；组合使用比任何单一模型效果更好。

architecture.en: ESMC builds a world model of protein biology, enabling structure prediction and design without MSAs.
architecture.zh: ESMC 构建了蛋白质生物学的世界模型，无需多序列比对即可进行结构预测和设计。

architecture.en: Mechanistic interpretability via sparse autoencoders reveals hierarchical features mirroring biology.
architecture.zh: 通过稀疏自编码器的机制可解释性揭示了与生物学对应的层次化特征。
